articleTitle: Tea Leaf Disease Detection Using Deep Learning-based Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Tea production is a crucial agricultural sector in India that significantly contributes to the country's economy. India is recognized as the world's top tea consumer and the second-largest producer of tea. This industry provides both direct and indirect employment to millions of individuals, especially those residing in rural areas, where it serves as a primary source of income. The growing popularity of deep learning has led to a significant increase in research interest in image recognition technologies, particularly in fields such as computerized image classification and the detection of plant diseases. Each year India produces a huge amount of tea leading to an increase in the economy. However, there is also a vast volume of tea waste because of the tea leaf disease which is required to be resolved to keep the constant industry's success. Diseases affecting tea leaves can impact their growth rate, thus affecting the crop's overall yield. Therefore, this study aims to develop a convolutional neural networks (CNNs) model to diagnose tea plant diseases using a collection of leaf images. CNN is an ideal model for this application as it can effectively analyze both tea leaves and other plant leaves to improve diagnostic accuracy. Additionally, the proposed method has analyzed the tea leaf images which achieved an accuracy rate of 84% along with a very less error rate which is 16% by using the “ADAM” optimizer. Furthermore, in the future, the images can also be enhanced with augmentation methods to achieve better results.

articleTitle: A Novel Method for Optimizing Numerical Solutions of Multi-Dimensional Itô-Volterra Stochastic Integral Equation Using Recurrent Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: This research study proposes a deep learning approach based on a recurrent neural network and it utilizes two popular types of RNNs - Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) and Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) and Monte Carlo simulation to effectively solve multi-dimensional stochastic Itô-Volterra integral equations (MSIVIE). In numerical experiments and practical applications, the proposed approach achieves reliability and great accuracy compared to current methods. Using optimization techniques such as Adam further enhances the model's performance. The adaptability of the approach is demonstrated through various scenarios, and error analysis is conducted to validate its efficacy. The numerical computations are implemented in Python and MATLAB. Consequently, provided visualizations such as loss function and actual and predicted function value graphs for a better understanding of the solution behaviour.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach for Song Recommendation System Using Deep Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: The song recommendation model is a powerful tool for improving user experience and engagement with streaming music services. Depending on user emotion recognition, the proposed Song suggester Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). The proposed model uses facial expressions to recognize the user's emotions, which are then used to recommend songs that match their mood. The model is trained on a large dataset of facial expressions and songs with emotional labels. The facial expression images are pre-processed using various image augmentation techniques and then fed into the CNN model for feature extraction. The extracted features are then used to predict the user's emotions, which are mapped to the corresponding emotional labels of songs. The recommended songs are then presented to the user, who can choose to add them to their playlist. The proposed model outperforms existing emotion-based song recommendation models and has the potential to enhance user experience in music streaming services with an accuracy of 93%.

articleTitle: Solar Power Prediction in North India Using Different Regression Models
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Prediction or forecasting the power output of a solar photovoltaic (PV) system is very important for the efficient planning of the energy distribution and utilization. This study uses machine learning algorithms such as linear regression, lasso regression, ridge regression, elastic net regression, support vector regression, and XGBoost regression to forecast the power production of a PV system installed at The NorthCap University, Gurugram (Delhi/NCR). The recorded data of irradiance and ambient temperature was collected from solar PV system over a three-month period which recorded every day at three-hour intervals. The data set includes 733 datapoints in three distinct dimensions: irradiance, ambient temperature, and power output from August to October 2022. The findings demonstrate that XGBoost Regression is the most accurate of the regression models examined, as per the R-squared value achieved between the predicted and actual power output values. All other models also behaved comparable for this data of August to October, as during these months the climate variations and hence irradiance variations are not unusual.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: Simulation and Analysis of Ammonium-Based Aeration Control Strategies to Enhance Efficiency in Wastewater Treatment Plant
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: This research adopts ammonium-based control strategies in a wastewater treatment plant (WWTP) using a fuzzy control approach. The main objective is to regulate the dissolved oxygen (DO) concentration in the last aeration tank and the nitrate concentration in the second anoxic tank. To achieve this, two fuzzy controllers, namely the “fuzzy DO” controller and the “fuzzy nitrate” controller, are employed. These controllers take the ammonia content in the last aeration tank as input and generate setpoints for the corresponding lower Proportional Integral (PI) controllers responsible for DO and nitrate control. The fuzzy DO controller plays a crucial role in maintaining the desired oxygen level within the wastewater treatment process by calculating suitable setpoints for the PI controller, thereby optimizing oxygen transfer within the tank. Similarly, the fuzzy nitrate controller dynamically adjusts the setpoint for the nitrate PI controller to ensure effective regulation of nitrate concentration. In addition, a separate PI controller is designed specifically for DO control in the fourth aeration tank, enhancing overall aeration control efficiency. The proposed control strategy was evaluated using Benchmark Simulation Model 1 (BSM1) to assess its effectiveness in achieving desired outcomes. Notable achievements include a remarkable 9.36% reduction in aeration energy consumption and a commendable 5.35% decrease in the violation of nitrogen concentration in the effluent. Although there is a slight increase of 0.6% in ammonia concentration violations, it remains well within acceptable limits. These results show that the suggested control strategy can increase the performance and efficiency of wastewater treatment plants.

articleTitle: Prediction of Age, Gender, and Ethnicity Using CNN and Facial Images in Real-Time
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Age, gender and ethnicity prediction is very important nowadays as it has many real-life applications in various types of fields but it is also a very challenging task because of reasons such as the complexity of facial appearance and lighting. Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) is a deep learning artificial neural network which has shown great success in solving this problem. CNNs use convolutional layers to extract characteristics from the input data and apply a set of filters to the data, which helps to identify different types of patterns in the data. The outputs of CNN are then passed through fully connected layers which perform classification based on the identified patterns. OpenCV is a machine learning library which is available as an open source that helps in performing real-time operations. This library detects objects through captured or real-time images or videos. We propose a real-time age, gender and ethnicity prediction system with the help of OpenCV and then pass it through CNN. In this paper, we trained three CNN models each for age, gender and ethnicity on the preprocessed dataset. We used a large-scale dataset containing facial images of different individuals with labels of all three attributes. We evaluated the performance of trained models on a test set of images and calculated benchmarks such as accuracy. We used OpenCV to capture real-time images from a webcam, preprocessed that image, and then used the trained CNN models to predict the age, gender and ethnicity of the captured image in real-time. The accuracy rates obtained from age, gender and ethnicity models are 82.5, 89.45 and 86.69 percent respectively.

articleTitle: Design of Multi-Bit Full Adder Using Low Power m-GDI Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: With recent advancements in VLSI circuits, adder circuits are constantly modified with different use of logic families such that power and area constraints are met. Full adder circuits have progressed from 28T to as low as 13T to satisfy the low-power technology nodes. This paper represents a novel approach to using twelve transistors to implement a full adder circuit. A hybrid technique of using transmission gate logic in combination with static complementary metal oxide semiconductors helps in accomplishing the functional and behavioral aspects of the circuit. The paper also examines the comparative analysis of traditional CMOS and TG logic full adder with the proposed hybrid-based full adder logic design. The analysis is based on the three input bits mainly 1, 4, and 8- bits respectively. Cadence virtuoso is used as the tool for the above study using GDPK 90nm technology. The parametric study helps in realizing the advantages of the circuit and the drawbacks to develop an enhanced full adder block.

articleTitle: Dynamic Capacity Increasing Method For Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: This paper studies a method and system for dynamic capacity increase of transmission lines. This paper measures the steady-state temperature data/transient temperature rise data of all parts of the conductor, and calculates the maximum steady-state current carrying capacity/maximum transient current carrying capacity through neural network model, which is more accurate than traditional methods; At the same time, this paper takes the last round of results as the training data of the new round of neural network model. With the continuous accumulation of actual operation data, the accuracy is further improved, which has good engineering practical value.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Blockchain-Based Approach for Intelligent Transportation System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Due to urbanization and an increase in people's lifestyles, the no. of vehicles is increasing. Efficient transportation and traffic management systems have become increasingly prominent. In recent years, advances have been made in the Internet of Vehicles (IoV) field. This has paved the way for the development of intelligent transportation systems (ITS). Advancements in communication systems, the Internet of Things, and cybersecurity have made it possible to achieve vehicular communication. With the introduction of smart cities, smart vehicles, and V2X technology, the development of a suitable environment for ITS has become more efficient. However, the existing system is centralized and poses security and privacy risks for IoV communication. Blockchain technology has been proposed to overcome security and privacy issues. Blockchain brings features such as decentralization, transparency, security, and immutability and cannot be corrupted. Communication between entities will become secure and tamper-proof. Hence, the system can operate smoothly in a trustless manner. The purpose of this article is to conduct a literature survey, put forth the latest advancements in the blockchain for ITS, and suggest a suitable solution for the same.

articleTitle: Automatic Person Detection in Search and Rescue Operations Using Deep Based MultiModel CNN Detectors
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Search and rescue operations are critical tasks where quick and accurate detection of humans can save lives. Due to growing number of people doing adventure tourism and going to other inaccessible places it is very important to organize a search and rescue operations to aid and health care to the needy. It's very difficult to find people who are relatively very small considering the area where they are. The detection of persons and objects in images and videos captured by drones during operations is of great importance, and thus, the ability to do so automatically is highly significant. Due to their ability to quickly capture a large, controlled area in a short amount of time, UAVs or drones are becoming increasingly involved in search operations. Despite the high success rate in detecting objects in normal ground captured images, detecting humans or other objects from UAVs (Unmanned Aerial Vehicles) still remains a challenging task in captured images or aerial images due to a few challenges like weather conditions, varying attitude, pose and scale variations, artefacts like people wearing hats and camouflaged environment. This project use CNN detectors for human detection in search and rescue operations.

articleTitle: Localization of Typical Defects in 220kV XLPE Submarine Cable Based on Frequency Domain Reflection Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Since cross-linked polyethylene (XLPE) insulated cables possess excellent insulation, mechanical and heat dissipation characteristics, they are widely used in the submarine cable transmission system, and the failure rate of them increases accordingly. Considering that submarine cables are usually unable to detect defects in a close range, how to quickly and accurately locate submarine cable faults becomes a big problem, which directly affects the operating stability and reliability of the system. In this paper, a method for locating typical defects in submarine cables based on the frequency domain reflection (FDR) technique was proposed. Firstly, the principle of defect location based on FDR was described in briefly. Then a 220 kV submarine cable model with four typical defects were fabricated, and it was used to verify the validity of the above method in locating defects. Results show that four typical defects in the submarine cable are all effectively identified and located, and the maximum location error is no more than 5%. This above research has a broad application prospect in the defect location and maintenance of submarine cables.

articleTitle: Revealing Multiple Lung Condition Using Deep Neural Network Models from X-RAY Images
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: This paper is about the predicting the accuracy of different optimal lung disease prediction models. Basically, in this, multiple lung diseases are detected by training on different models of CNN and used deep learning algorithm as it works well with large number of datasets as various dimensions and features of images as well as textual data can be investigated. Lung infections/diseases can be detected by taking blood tests etc. but it is expensive. So, this paper aims towards comparison done to find the most accurate model which can predict using x-rays to reduce the cost and time of the conduct. Image classification models and segmentation techniques like VGG19, NASNet, DenseNet, MobileNetV2, ResNetV2, EfficientNetB0, InceptionV3,etc. can be utilized to detect lung infections and illnesses. The primary limitation of traditional methods is the semantic gap between the high-level semantic information that humans perceive and the low-level visual information that imaging technologies gather. The deep convolutional neural network was developed to eliminate the difficulty in maintaining and querying enormous datasets. After performing different CNN models, DenseNet121gives the best accuracy. The obtained accuracy of the model after 15<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> epoch is like 100 % of training accuracy, 0.0011 is training loss, 98.7% of validation accuracy and 0.0462 is validation error. The obtained results show the performance of various models, and which one is good and can be used as a secondary opinion tool by medical experts.

articleTitle: Big Data and Artificial Intelligence in Education: A Bibliometrics Study from 2010 to 2023
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: In the digital era, it is necessary to promote talent cultivation and education reform with the help of big data. In order to understand the development status of education big data and AI education, this paper takes Web of Science (WoS) 2010–2023 as the data source, and uses the visualization software CiteSpace and VOSviewer to conduct quantitative analysis and visualization of relevant literature. Through co-citation analysis and co-occurrence network analysis, cluster analysis is conducted on authors, publishing institutions and high-frequency keywords to explore and analyze the hot spots, evolution paths and development trends of education big data and AI education research. At the same time, the highly cited literature and representative scholars are analyzed to further understand the trend of the field. Conclusions from the study(1) In the past decade, the scope of research in this field has been expanding and the research content has been gradually deepening.(2) Although researchers in this field have different focuses, they have formed stable cooperative relationships.(3) Most papers in this field have been published in journals related to educational technology and computational intelligence, and open source journals have promoted research in this field. (4) Research in this field has prompted some scholars to pay attention to data privacy, data quality issues, and ethical issues.

articleTitle: Tweeting Truth: Investigating False Information on Twitter Using Data Analysis and a Proposed Detection Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: The emergence of social media platforms has revolutionized information dissemination and news gathering across various fields. Despite its benefits, it has also made it easier for false information to spread rapidly, necessitating the need to identify and put a stop to it. It has also become a breeding ground for spammers who propagate fake content. The aim of this study is to classify news as authentic, false, or uncertain and to prevent the spread of misleading and inaccurate information. We aim to provide a comprehensive understanding of the current landscape of Twitter fake news detection by conducting an in-depth analysis of the latest state-of-the-art models, which includes a comparison of their effectiveness as well as an assessment of their strengths and weaknesses. Following that, we have presented the problem statement, research objectives, and proposed methodology for detecting and preventing false information. To gain a deeper understanding of the prevalence and nature of fake news on social media, we conducted exploratory data analysis on Twitter, which is currently the most widely used platform for sharing information and engaging with others. After thoroughly examining the dataset, we have found a considerable presence of false tweets, emphasizing the pressing need for more effective methods to detect and counteract misinformation. These findings have important implications for social media platforms, news organizations, and policymakers. The motivation behind this work is to fight against the spread of inaccurate information and to tackle the problem of spammers who promote the fake content. Our objective is to offer an advanced solution that utilizes state-of-the-art technology to achieve exceptional performance and effectively address this problem. The innovative hybrid deep learning method we propose integrates cutting-edge natural language processing capabilities including NoR_BeRT, Du_BRO, and MAC_BiGNet at different stages such as feature extraction, feature selection and classification, ensuring superior precision.

articleTitle: Enhancing Cardiovascular Health: A Machine Learning Approach to Predicting Heart Disease
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Heart disease is a significant threat to health worldwide, making early detection and diagnosis important for treatment and prevention. To predict cardiac illness, we used a range of machine learning models in this study, including Logistic Regression, Random Forest, Extreme Gradient Boosting, and Support Vector Machine. The models were trained and evaluated using a dataset of patient medical records that included various health measures, including blood pressure, cholesterol levels, and other risk factors. According to the results, the Support Vector Machine model had an accuracy of 93.51%, while the Random Forest model had a maximum accuracy of 94.16%. Accuracy rates for Logistic Regression and Extreme Gradient Boost were 85.71% and 90.26%, respectively. These results highlight the method machine learning algorithms used to predict heart disease, enabling earlier diagnosis and better disease management.

articleTitle: SRDRN-IR: A Super Resolution Deep Residual Neural Network for IR Images
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Human perception is only capable of perceiving a few objects outside the range of wavelengths for visible light in the electromagnetic spectrum. It restricts humans' ability to discriminate things in a variety of situations, such as dim light or under smoke and fog. The development of thermographic imaging technology has made it possible to see items that are invisible to the naked eye. This enables its usage in many sectors, such as defence, agriculture, healthcare, etc. Thermal cameras have low spatial resolution in comparison to the same-range RGB cameras due to hardware constraints. A deep neural network architecture, SRDRN, is proposed in this study for Super-Resolution (SR) of IR images. SRDRN uses the channel splitting concept with residual learning for computationally efficient super resolution. The viability of the proposed design is validated by analysing it with the available thermal image datasets.

Author Keywords: Super Resolution Deep Residual Neural Network for IR images (SRDRN-IR)

articleTitle: Live Virtual Machine Migration Techniques in Cloud Computing: A Review
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: The act of moving a running virtual machine (VM) from one physical host to another, without interruption to its services or resulting in downtime, is called virtual machine migration. Live virtual machine migration (LVMM) is a vital component of cloud computing that enables scalability, reliability, and load balancing capabilities in virtualized environments, with no apparent downtime for the end-user. This research paper outlines several LVMM methods and provide an analysis on the basis of downtime, total migration and total data transfer

articleTitle: Energy System Planning and Intelligent Regulation and Optimization based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Energy is an important part of social progress and development, but in today's rapid development of society, the demand for energy is increasing. At the same time, environmental pollution and imbalance in energy demand reduce the rationality of energy. To analyze energy system planning, so that energy conservation, emission reduction, efficient utilization, planning and design and intelligent regulation and control can be better optimized. Then, the smart assessment data is evaluated comprehensively. Finally, continuous monitoring is used to analyze energy system planning. The artificial intelligence recognition algorithm can accurately carry out energy system planning and analysis, energy system planning, and the rationality is greater than 85 % is better than genetic arithmetic.

articleTitle: A Long Short-Term Memory Based Neural Network Approach for Numerical Solutions of Integral Equations
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: In this paper, neural networks with long short-term memories have been used to solve integral equations. The integral equations have been discretized using a Monte-Carlo method. While neural networks have been widely used for various applications, their application to integral equations, especially in conjunction with LSTMs, is relatively unexplored which is filled by this paper. By discretizing the stochastic integral equations into a system of linear algebraic equations, the proposed method provides a practical solution that can be easily implemented and computationally efficient. This addresses a practical gap in solving integral equations, as traditional methods can often be complex and time-consuming. The use of Monte-Carlo methods allows for a probabilistic approach, which can handle the inherent randomness in some integral equations. A numerical example of the Fredholm Integral equation has been provided to show how adaptable our suggested systems are. Adam optimization has been used to create a neural network model based on long short-term memory in order to find solutions. Loss function graphs, actual and predicted function value graphs, and other visualizations have also been described to provide a better grasp of the behavior of the solutions based on our suggested methodology.

articleTitle: Enhancing ORB-SLAM3 with YOLO-based Semantic Segmentation in Robotic Navigation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: This research paper presents an enhanced version of ORB-SLAM3 by integrating it with YOLOv8 for real-time pose estimation and semantic segmentation. ORB-SLAM3 is a state-of-the-art monocular visual SLAM system that uses an ORB feature detector and descriptor to track the camera motion and estimate the 3D map of the environment. However, ORB-SLAM3 lags with the ability to detect and segment objects, which limits its potential applications in robotics and autonomous systems. To address this limitation, we propose to integrate YOLOv8, a high-performance object detection and segmentation framework, into ORB-SLAM3. Our enhanced system combines the strengths of ORB-SLAM3 and YOLOv8, providing accurate and real-time detection and segmentation of objects in complex environments. We evaluate the system on a publicly available dataset and demonstrate that the enhanced system outperforms the baseline ORB-SLAM3 in terms of accuracy and computational efficiency. The system has potential applications in various fields, including robotics, autonomous systems, and augmented reality.

articleTitle: Effect of Input Data and Parameters of Genetic Algorithm on Lithium-Ion Battery Modeling
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Lithium-ion battery is the workhorse for spacecraft applications. It supports loads during launch, eclipse, peak power requirements and maneuvering. The Lithium-ion battery degrades during mission life. The degradation affects mission planning. Hence there is a need to model battery performance during its lifetime. The authors propose A genetic algorithm-based model in earlier work to obtain the figure of merits, namely, deliverable capacity and battery resistance. The robustness of the model needs to be ascertained to find its applicability for different scenarios. The battery parameters (namely, voltage, current, and temperature) from the spacecraft in orbit are sampled a few seconds apart. The amount of battery data transmitted back to the earth is limited as a spacecraft has hundreds of health parameters. Geosynchronous orbit data consisting of battery current and temperature is taken as input. The simulated voltage is compared with the experimental voltage to calculate the figure of merits. The effect of the amount of experimental input data and the parameters of the genetic algorithm on the accuracy of voltage and capacity is analyzed. The capacity estimation is affected by the amount of data and GA parameters (error doubled from 1% to 2%), and voltage errors remain unaffected (root mean square error of 0.3%) for the simulated battery model.

articleTitle: Developing REM Sleep Prediction Models Using Smart Home Sensor Data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: In this study, we discuss the development of a model for predicting the duration of REM (rapid eye movement) sleep utilizing sensor data from smart homes. It has been noted that a shortage of REM sleep is associated with increased cardiovascular strain and a heightened risk of overwork-related fatalities. Therefore, it is crucial to provide users with a system that offers advice on their daily sleep, activity, and environmental habits to obtain high-quality sleep. However, collecting sleep data continuously for an extended period is impractical. We aim to develop a reliable model that predicts the duration of REM sleep using sensor data with missing values collected from smart homes. The model utilizes data on the users' sleep, activity, and environmental conditions for several days. This study uses Boruta as the feature selection method, adopts Random Forest as the machine learning technique, and utilizes LOPO-CV and MAE as evaluation methods. The predictive accuracy of the proposed model surpassed that of models trained solely on historical REM sleep data or those without any variable selection. Further examining the relationship between selected features and REM sleep may lead to developing a personalized system that can enhance the quality of users' sleep.

articleTitle: Fusion of Transformer Model and Skeleton Detection Model for Abnormal Human Activity Detection with Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Abnormal activity detection is an area of study that focuses on finding abnormal activities like theft, vandalism, abuse, etc in video and CCTV footage. In this paper, a combination of skeleton based and transformer-based approach is used. The skeletons are used to enrich the motion of human bodies in the video. The transformer is used to model dynamic convolutions which helps to overcome the problems associated with fixed size kernels. To preserve the background information the architecture also uses feature extraction. The methodology used in the paper, also proposed a way to use transfer learning in the transformer network. The proposed framework provides excellent results outperforming many of existing methodologies. ROC (AUC score) attained by the proposed method for some classes of actions are up to 97.71%, which is even higher than current state of art approaches. The average ROC (AUC score) of our method is better than many of the approaches which are considered in the paper.

articleTitle: Stock Market Forecasting Using Hyperparameter-Tuned Ensemble Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Stock market forecasting is fascinating due to the financial interests associated with it. The conventional method uses Technical Indicators (TI) as part of market analysis, whereas computer-assisted modelling includes Machine Learning (ML) for market analysis. This paper presents an ML-based stock market forecasting model in which Technical Indicators (TI) along with historical stock data are used to forecast the stock market movement. Tree-based ensemble models are trending due to their robust performance. XGBoost is one such tree-based ensemble model. However, hyperparameters of XGBoost are quite difficult to select. Therefore, an automatic selection of hyperparameters is required. This paper proposes optimized XGBoost in which popularly used optimization methods are utilized for hyperparameter optimization. For hyperparameter tuning, Grid Search (GS), Random Search (RS), Bayesian Optimization (BO), and Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) are used. The performance of the hyperparameter-tuned XGBoost is tested on the three stock indices i.e. NIFTY, NASDAQ, and NYSE. The standard performance metrics Accuracy (ACC), Precision (P), Recall (R), and F1-Score (F1) are used for the model evaluation. Empirical studies show that PSO-optimized XGBoost provides the highest performance whereas GS-optimized XGBoost provides the lowest performance.

articleTitle: Lung Cancer Detection Using VGG16 and CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Globally, lung cancer constitutes a significant contributor to cancer-related complications, with early identification playing a critical role in enhancing patient prognosis. In recent times, machine learning approaches, particularly convolutional neural networks (CNNs), have demonstrated notable success in automating lung cancer detection using medical diagnostic tools. This study aims to explore the potential of a pre-trained VGG16 and CNN model in detecting lung cancer through the analysis of histopathological images. We utilize openly accessible dataset containing lung tissue histopathological images for training and assessing our model. Our evaluation reveals that the VGG16 CNN model effectively discerns cancerous conditions in lung tissue images with remarkable precision.

articleTitle: Fault Location Optimisation For Transmission Line Using Chaotic Artificial Hummingbird Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel fault location technique for a three phase transmission line based on Artificial Hummingbird Algorithm and Chaotic Concept. Chaotic Concept is integrated with Artificial Hummingbird Algorithm to improve the solution quality. A new chaotic algorithm motivated by the biological process of flight skills of hummingbirds and chaotic algorithm, known as the Chaotic Artificial Hummingbird Algorithm is put forward in this paper to accurately detect the point of fault occurrence in transmission line. The proposed algorithm has been checked using the Simulink model in MATLAB for a 400kV, 300km transmission line. Signals of voltages and currents are taken from the duo ends of the overhead transmitting wire. The algorithm suggested has been applied to various kinds of symmetrical and asymmetrical faults.

articleTitle: A Machine Learning based approach to Detect Birds over and around the Runway before they Strike the Aircrafts
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: This project aims to benefit the aviation industry by using machine learning techniques, specifically the You Only Look Once (YOLO) algorithm, to detect potential obstacles in real-time during flight. The system uses high-resolution cameras installed in the airports to provide pilots with advance warning of most potential threats, of birds, before they become a danger. This approach significantly reduces the risk of accidents and enhances the safety of air travel. The system's successful implementation can revolutionize the aviation industry, setting new standards in flight safety.

articleTitle: Real Time Sign Language Recognition Using Yolov5
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: This paper proposes real-time sign language detection models for deaf and mute individuals created using the You Only Look Once version 5 (YOLOv5) algorithm. There were 3 different models created. The first model detects American Sign Language, the Second model detects Hindi/ Marathi Sign Language and the third model detects static gestures. The YOLOv5 models were trained on the custom data set, achieving high accuracy. The model's real-time performance was evaluated by capturing live sign language gestures using a webcam, achieving an average detection time of 0.05 seconds per frame. This demonstrates the model's potential for real-time sign language interpretation and communication for deaf and mute individuals. To implement the models, our custom data set includes a total of 1892 images, consisting of 452 training images of static gestures, 611 training images of Hindi/Marathi sign language, and 829 training images for American sign language representing different sign language gestures. The proposed models performed better than other deep learning models, including Faster R-CNN and Mask R-CNN, showing superior accuracy and real-time performance. The results demonstrate the potential of using YOLOv5-based models for real-time sign language detection and interpretation, which can significantly improve the quality of life for deaf and mute individuals.

articleTitle: Design of Wideband Wilkinson Power Divider for Sub-6Ghz Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Power dividers or combiners are crucial parts of any RF subsystems and network for determining efficient performance. In complex circuits, for instance, rectifiers, amplifiers, etc these splitters and combiners play a major role in combining the inputs or division of power at outputs. Amongst all types of power dividers, Wilkinson Power Divider is considered to be the easiest in terms of designing and deployment while achieving enhanced characteristics at the desired band. The need of the hour is to attain a wideband characteristic while avoiding the unnecessary expansion of the design structure. However, at lower microwave frequencies it is definite for the design to be large and bulky because of the increase in wavelength. In this proposed work, a 2-way Wilkinson power divider is reported for the operating frequency of 3.8 GHz lying in the Sub-6GHz band. The single-stage Wilkinson power divider has been further modified to a multi-stage Wilkinson power divider to achieve a bandwidth of nearly 4 GHz with a compact size at the same time. Furthermore, the ultimate design has been analyzed in terms of other parameters such as insertion loss, return loss, and isolation.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Intelligent Agricultural System Using NB-IOT
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: India is an agriculturally rich country, considering the fact that over 60 to 70% population here belong to the farming background. Agriculture contributes about 20% of the total Gross Domestic Product. In the early days farming is been done using traditional methods where there is a certain level of hardship which used to be included. With the evolving technology today, different techniques are being developed using the Internet of Things just to ease farming methods. The main objective of this paper is a solution developed using Narrow Band Internet of Things (NB-IoT) and Cloud Techniques, to monitor the soil moisture content and control the motor accordingly. The developed NB-IOT set-up consists of multiple sensors and various factors, to reduce the over usage of resources including high time, power consumption, cost, water, and waste of the water by implementing innovative techniques to follow precision agriculture.

articleTitle: Analysis of Metasurface Unit Cell Geometry on Wideband THz Antenna Design
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: The future generation communication systems demand high communication, internet speed and bandwidth networks which has resulted in increased research thrust in THz application and communication. These THz applications and communications require designing state of the art antenna designs. Metasurfaces (MTS) and metamaterials assist in design of THz antennas. The extensive literature review suggests that some research gap is there in the specification stage of antenna design. The existing antenna designs lack design flow diagrams and operate on relatively low bandwidths with fewer resonant frequencies. In this research paper, a focus on the developmental progress of metasurface antennas is discussed and this paper explores the effect of shape of metasurface unit cell structure on the operational bandwidth of the antennas operating in the THz range. The performance of the metasurface based antennas is evaluated and compared. In the first case the unit cell structure is made up of square geometry and in the second case a triangular shaped unit cell structure is used to create an array of metasurface layer over the slotted patch antenna. The improved performance of triangular shaped unit cell array over square shaped unit cell structure and the results are presented in a novel and comparably comprehensible manner. The results cover the research gap of design flow diagrams and proposes a design of THz antenna with a bandwidth of nearly 8 THz with 6 resonant frequencies.

articleTitle: Multimodality Imaging Data-Driven Prediction Architecture for Breast Cancer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Breast cancer is a significant public health concern and one of the primary causes of cancer-related fatalities among women worldwide. Early identification and diagnosis of breast cancer are critical for successful treatment and enhanced patient outcomes. Deep learning algorithms have shown significant potential in identifying and diagnosing breast cancer in recent years. This study presents a method for classifying breast cancer into three categories: Normal, Benign, and Malignant, based on a combination of five transfer learning architectures. This paper proposes a stacked approach for progressively learning and combining multimodal features for the classification using Computer Tomography (CT) and ultrasound images (UT). The entire image is first converted into high-level features for each modality by building a deep 3D-CNN. To combine the most important attributes for image classification, the suggested stacking of VGG-19, ResNet-50, Inception-V3, Xception, DenseNet-121, and MobileNet-V2 models is proposed. The proposed stacking approach achieved an accuracy of 94.01%, 92.33% and 91.21% for Malignant, Benign and Normal. Results showed that compared to preexisting individual learners, the proposed ensemble model achieves higher accuracy both globally and inside individual classes.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of Hybrid Deep Sentimental Analysis Learning Techniques with CNN and SVM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: People are becoming more and more engaged with digital touchpoints and social platforms as a result of technological advancements. Each interaction is generating a lot of data in form of text, images, audio files, and videos. However, the most comprehensive form of user-generated data is still text. One of the text mining applications that is gaining prominence is sentiment analysis. By analysing the tone of online product reviews, any business can learn more about the opinions and thoughts of its customers. To learn more about the ideas and sentiments of customers, a variety of unique approaches and procedures are applied. Deep Learning models have been developed by numerous researchers in the past and many of the research did focus on standalone models like CNN and LSTM. In this article, we suggest a method to further increase the classification's overall accuracy by combining deep convolutional neural networks (CNN) and support vector machines (SVM). The CNN, SVM, 1DCNN, and LSTM networks were used to analyse the sentiments in this study. The dataset comes from Kaggle and is called Amazon Product Review Dataset.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Information Screening Algorithm of Japanese Network Corpus Based on Computer Corpus
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Corpus is a collection of data that contains a large amount of real language information and can be processed by computer. Using corpus to study the characteristics of language has become one of the most important applications of corpus. At present, corpus based linguistic research is in the ascendant and is becoming one of the new research methods in linguistics. Discourse analysis is also a study of real corpus. The combination of the two can inject new vitality into the study of discourse analysis. With the deepening of the research on information screening of Japanese network corpus, some problems to be solved gradually appear. This paper reviews the background and research paradigm of corpus based discourse analysis model, looks forward to the future research, and points out the existing problems and challenges of this research paradigm. The innovation of information teaching methods and the diversification trend of foreign language teaching methods. With the vigorous development of the Internet, big data and artificial intelligence and other technologies, foreign language teaching methods inevitably move towards the direction of informatization and dataization, and the diversified development of teaching methods, the use of advanced information and multimedia technology to provide students with an effective language learning environment, but also poses challenges to teachers' teaching ability. The teaching methods, teaching content, and teaching methods of the Japanese language major must be further optimized to meet the needs of students and society in the new era. While facing the above challenges, it is necessary to seize the development opportunities, innovate teaching reforms, and respond to the needs of the times and society for the development of Japanese language majors. These urgently require the intervention of new language teaching methods.

articleTitle: Design of Novel Optimization Algorithm based Maximum Power Point Tracking for Solar Photovoltaic Application
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: In the present investigation, the Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) of a 250 Wp solar PV model is validated in rapidly changing atmospheric conditions using Horse Herd Optimization (HHO) methodologies. Traditional MPPT algorithms cannot cope with quickly changing atmospheric conditions. As a result, the HHO algorithm is proposed as a solution to this problem in the research. The novel algorithm can handle both normal and rapidly changing atmospheric conditions. The approach is evaluated using MATLAB/Simulink software under rapidly varying shading conditions to demonstrate its efficiency. To evaluate the proposed algorithm perturb and observe (P&O) is utilized to compare.

articleTitle: Complete Vehicle Controller Design Developed with AT32F413 as the Core Control Chip
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Due to the lack of cores or even no cores available for car companies, it also leads to the inability to produce the whole vehicle controller, which is still the core of pure electric vehicles and urgently needs a replaceable chip. In order to improve the above problems, in this paper, we use the replacement chip AT32F413 as the main controller chip, and firstly design the hardware module, and then use Simulink software to build the control model and use the model to generate the code automatically. After each module code is generated, the template TLC file performs task scheduling to complete the automatic combination of the vehicle logic code and the application layer code. The combined code is compiled in Keil and then the BIN file is downloaded to the vehicle controller hardware via the CAN bus. The individual modules can be summarized and packaged as Simulink libraries for multi-platform reuse. Subsequently, actual vehicle testing is performed to finally verify its feasibility to meet its development requirements.

articleTitle: Modern Architectural Environment Design Based on Computer Vision Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: With the continuous development of computer vision technology, people have gradually realized its important role in solving engineering problems. This paper mainly analyzes and discusses the design process of modern architectural environment. In order to make the modern building environment more reasonable and meet the needs of consumers, this paper uses computer vision algorithm to monitor the building environment in real time and calculate the best plan. This paper mainly uses the experimental design and investigation and analysis methods, and carries out data statistics and discusses the results through principal component analysis. According to the survey data, only 17% of people think that their living environment is just right, which shows the importance of modern architectural environment design.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Credit Bank Information Management System Model Based on Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: With the continuous development of blockchain technology, its application in the field of credit supervision is becoming increasingly widespread. This article took bank credit as an example to analyze the credit risk management system constructed based on blockchain technology. The system used blockchain as an information sharing platform for data storage and management, and established corresponding security measures for transaction processes, payment and settlement, so as to provide online monitoring functions. By establishing a dynamic supervision mechanism for the entire process of financial business, the automation of credit default warning and processing work was achieved. Afterwards, this article also tested the performance of the model. The test results showed that the memory usage of the credit bank information management system model based on blockchain technology was between 1% and 5%.

articleTitle: Design of an Efficient Hybrid-Attack Classification and Mitigation Model for Heterogeneous Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Wireless networks have become an integral part of modern communication systems. However, they are vulnerable to security threats due to the inherent nature of wireless communication. Existing attack detection & mitigation models either work on a limited set of attacks, or cannot be scaled for larger network scenarios. To overcome such issues, this paper proposes the design of an efficient hybrid-attack classification and mitigation model for heterogeneous wireless networks. The model initially collects contextual communication data samples from different network components and uses a hybrid approach that combines Antlion Optimization (ALO) with Analytical Hierarchical Processing (AHP) rule-based systems to classify and mitigate different types of attacks in wireless networks. The proposed model is designed to work in heterogeneous wireless networks, where different types of devices with different capabilities and specifications are connected to the same set of network scenarios. The model was tested on realtime attacks including Denial of Service (DoS), Man-in-the-Middle (MitM), and Rogue Access Point (RAP) attacks. It was observed that the model was capable of mitigating these attacks with 9.5% higher accuracy, 4.9% higher precision, and 2.5% lower delay when compared with existing models. Thus, the proposed model can assist in enhancing the security of wireless networks and provide better protection against network threats.

articleTitle: Potato Leaf Disease Detection Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: India is one of the largest producers of potato crop in the whole world. Potato is responsible for the significant crop production statistics in India. It's contribution is over 27.8 percent of the total crop which is grown in our country. But due to some plant diseases the health of the potato plant gets adversely affected which leads to great economic losses which directly affects the nation's economy as well. Due to illiteracy and poor knowledge of botany and plants farmers used to suffer terrific amount of economic losses. The traditional methods used by farmers were not up to the mark. In earlier times the farmers used to detect if the plant is healthy, or it has some sort of disease. This method is obviously not very productive and also, very cumbersome. So with the help of new technology, we can detect the problem very easily within fraction of seconds and it also provide very optimized results. We have a dataset called Plant village which has more than 2000 images of different leaves. In our project we will give our input image and our model will then predict weather the potato leaf is disease free or not. And if there is any disease then it will figure out whether it is early blight or late blight. We will use Deep learning in our project for optimum result. We will also use various algorithms such as ANN, CNN and apply the one which yield us the most accurate results. It was concluded that CNN gives the outstanding results amongst all with an accuracy of 98.72 percent.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Quad-Element MIMO Antenna Applied to the Wideband Transmission
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: The design of a 4x4 MIMO antenna for Wideband (C-X-Ku-K-band) communication systems is presented in this work. The single antenna element is comprised of a semicircular ring structure with circular holes backed by a modified partial ground plane having dimensions of 23x21mm2. To increase the antenna bandwidth and gain, the defective ground structure is implemented with semi-circular structure & slots. The single antenna element has a wide impedance bandwidth of 18.23 GHz and operates from 4.40 GHz to 22.63 GHz. For MIMO applications, a 4 x 4 array is designed and analyzed on FR - 4 substrate material having dimensions of 42x38x1.6mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>. The proposed MIMO antenna provides wideband response from 4.19 GHz to over 24.59 GHz having fractional bandwidth of 141.76%. It is mentioning that good isolation characteristics more than 20dB are achieved without the utilization of any isolation enhancement network. The radiation and diversity performances of the antenna are evaluated, and the obtained metrics are ECC < 0.025, DG ≈ 10 dB, TARC < 0.5, and CCL <0.3 bits/s/Hz. The proposed antenna is believed to have a valuable prospect in UWB communication, Wireless Body Area Network, ISM, mobile communication applications, etc.

articleTitle: Quality Evaluation of Circular Aperture Antennas
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Circular aperture antennas require deductions of mathematical expressions that involve integrating Bessel functions. The analysis of Fourier Integral of a Circular Aperture Antenna is important to understand the behavior of this type of antenna. Fourier analysis can be used to calculate the antenna radiation patterns and the field distribution in far-field region. It is also useful for designing reflector antennas and calculating the impedance parameters, like input impedance and radiation resistance. In addition, Fourier Integral can be used to calculate Bessel coefficients which are necessary when computing the far-field pattern using Bessel function expansions. In this paper, we will examine various properties of these integrals, such as their range of validity, accuracy, and numerical stability. We will also discuss the use cases for this integral in antenna design and analysis as well as its limitations. The results obtained from this study may help to improve the performance of circular aperture antennas in different applications.

articleTitle: Study on Pulse Low-Frequency Excitation Model and its Winding Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: In this paper, we propose and discuss a new excitation model for low-frequency electromagnetic induction. First, the hardware principle and frequency domain mathematical expression of the model are given, and then the gain equation with the traditional RLC resonance model is obtained. In order to accurately obtain the inductance of the excitation winding under different structures, the factors affecting self-induction and mutual inductance of the solenoid multi-layer winding are analyzed in detail. Finally, through reasonable assumptions and the characteristics of inductance processing, the gain equation is necessary to be deformed and simplified, and is directly displayed in the three-dimensional surface graph.

articleTitle: Analysis of Aerodynamic Characteristics of UAV Wing under Icing Condition
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: With the development of UAV technology, it has been widely used in more and more fields. At present, UAV has the characteristics of quick response, high efficiency, complete functions and complex internal structure. When unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) flies in complex weather conditions, its wing surface is also easy to freeze. After the wing freezes, it not only increases the flight weight, but also changes the aerodynamic shape of the UAV, resulting in the increase of wing resistance, the decrease of lift, the decrease of stall angle of attack, the increase of stall speed and the deterioration of maneuverability and stability, which poses a serious threat to flight safety. In this study, the aerodynamic characteristics and structural characteristics of UAV icing wings are analyzed based on hydrodynamics and structural dynamics from the perspective of UAV safety.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Assembling Algorithms Under Various Models of Synchrony and Mobility
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: This paper inspects the performance of two existing assembling algorithms after calibrating some useful parameters associated to the environment and robot characteristics in a swarm robotic system by using simulation. The impact of parameters like synchrony, mobility, number of robots and number of obstacles are observed and analyzed for two models of axes agreement namely, full compass model and direction only model. The comparison is made on the basis of maximum number of computation cycles taken by each algorithm to assemble the robots in the boundary. Results of the simulation show that when non-rigidity is assumed in the semi-synchronous model, the performance of both the models deteriorate significantly compared to other combinations.

articleTitle: Technological Intervention: Prevention of Crime Using AI and IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: This paper study the use of artificial intelligence (AI) and Internet of Things (IoT) technologies for the prevention of offences against states. The purpose of this paper is to examine the use cases of AI and IoT technologies in the prevention of offences against states, including surveillance, cyber security, and data analysis. The paper also examines the benefits of using AI and IoT technologies in combination, as well as the challenges and ethical considerations in their implementation. The implications for future research and the use of AI and IoT technologies in the prevention of offences against states are also discussed. Overall, this paper highlights the potential of AI and IoT technologies in enhancing security and presenting offences against states, while also emphasizing the importance of addressing the challenges and ethical considerations associated with their implementation.

articleTitle: Peripheral Oxygen Saturation Measurement: Could the Wrist be an Alternative Site for a Finger?
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Wearable devices capable of monitoring oxygen saturation levels have become increasingly popular due to their convenience, portability, and potential for continuous monitoring. The variation in <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{SpO}_{2}$</tex> measurements at the finger and wrist depends on the penetration depth of the wavelengths, signal quality, and signal-to-noise ratios since these regions have different blood perfusion characteristics and vascular structures. There are limitations in using the Red and IR Wavelengths, which are used in conventional pulse oximeters, to be employed for the wrist region. The evaluation of the effect of different combinations of wavelengths at the finger and wrist demonstrates which region provides higher accuracy at multiple wavelengths. Since the fingertip-attached devices limit users' ability to move their hands freely, efforts have been taken to design and validate wrist-worn technologies to measure <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{SpO}_{2}$</tex>. Method: A Multispectral-based wrist-worn wearable Photoplethysmographic (MSPPG) device employs an optical bio-sensing, integrated BIOFY sensor to acquire the Photoplethysmographic (PPG) signals using three LEDs (Green-526nm, Red-660 nm, and IR- <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$950\text{nm}$</tex>) and photo-detectors. The signals are acquired from the finger as well as from the wrist region of healthy volunteers, which are processed to obtain the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{SpO}_{2}$</tex> measurements keeping a standard pulse oximeter as a gold standard reference. The <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{SpO}2$</tex> obtained using the MSPPG signal from the finger and wrist is compared with the standard pulse oximeter. The comparison is made between <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{Standard}_{-}\text{SpO}_{2}$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{Finger}_{-}\text{MSPPG}_{-}\text{SpO}_{2}, \text{Standard}_{-}\text{SpO}_{2}$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{Wrist}_{-}\text{MSPPG}_{-}\text{SpO}_{2},\text{Finger}_{-}\text{MSPPG}_{-}\text{SpO}_{2}$</tex>, and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{Wrist}_{-}\text{MSPPG}_{-}\text{SpO}_{2}$</tex>. The statistical analysis is performed using the Student's paired t-test and Pearson correlation coefficient, which confirms that the wrist shows greater accuracy while using the Green and IR combination of wavelengths. Conclusion: Wearable PPG-based devices face a significant issue of motion artifacts which can be overcome by using MSPPG. The research advancements can potentially increase the accessibility of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{SpO}_{2}$</tex> monitoring in resource-limited areas

articleTitle: Smart Traffic Lights
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Due to the chaotic nature of day-to-day traffic density trends, the current traffic management system needs to be immediately improved. The timers in the system have a predetermined amount of time to switch the direction of traffic flow. Because of this, even though there is little traffic density, vehicles must wait longer. As a workaround, the signal timer can be programmed to vary based on the variation in traffic density. This has a great deal of other advantages and can greatly lessen traffic congestion. The suggested system intends to improve the current traffic management system and concentrates on four-way crossings with square traffic signals. The model uses machine learning and image processing to process and estimate actual traffic on the roads. The system will then figure out how long each road will take before turning on the signal. The system is an intelligent spoof of a conventional traffic officer who has successfully made wiser choices to guarantee the intersection's efficient flow of traffic.

articleTitle: Challenges and Open Issues in Designing MAC Protocols for UAV Networks : A Review
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) possess significant potential in the public and civil sectors, particularly in scenarios where human safety is jeopardized. The utilization of multiple Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAV) systems is a more economically viable and operationally efficient approach compared to using a single UAV system. However, before providing secure and efficient networks by UAVs, it is imperative to tackle various challenges. UAV networks exhibit dynamic characteristics, encompassing a range of speeds and intermittent links while featuring a topology subject to change. The Media Access Control (MAC) encounters supplementary difficulties in the context of a multi-UAV system, owing to the dynamic mobility trait of UAVs. Consequently, UAV network protocols must exhibit adaptability to optimize channel resource utilization and guarantee effective communication among multiple UAVs. The present study investigates the challenges involved in designing MAC protocols, presents a comprehensive survey of the existing MAC protocols, and outlines their respective merits and demerits. Ultimately, the paper outlines prospective possibilities for research in MAC protocol design

articleTitle: 3D Geological Modeling of Assembled Building Engineering Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Dimensional geological modeling refers to a new technology that uses computer information technology to combine spatial information, geological data, geographic interpretation images, scientific computing visualization and other tools in a three-dimensional space environment, and applies them to geographic analysis. In order to solve the shortcomings of the existing research on 3D geological modeling of prefabricated buildings, based on the discussion of BP neural network and classification of prefabricated buildings, the basic process of 3D geological modeling and the characteristics of 3D geological information, this paper briefly discusses the GOCAD modeling software and 3D geological model including non geometric attributes. The 3D geological modeling system of prefabricated building engineering is designed, and the 3D geological modeling of prefabricated building engineering geological reservoir based on BP neural network is proposed. The specific numerical simulation of geological reservoir information parameters is carried out through BP neural network. The experimental results show that the root mean square error and the average absolute error of the algorithm are only 0.004 and 0.01 at the lowest. Therefore, the feasibility of 3D geological modeling of prefabricated building engineering based on BP neural network is verified.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach: Load Balancing With Fault Tolerant Technique to Solve Hidden Node Problem in Mobile Ad hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: This paper addresses the hidden terminal problem in Mobile Ad hoc Networks (MANETs) through the use of enhanced load balancing technique with fault-tolerant mechanisms. The proposed approach aims to distribute network traffic efficiently and ensure resilience in the presence of faults or failures. Evaluation of the technique was performed using NS-2 simulations, considering metrics such as delay, throughput, and packet delivery ratio. The simulation results demonstrated significant improvements in these metrics, validating the effi-ciency of the suggested strategy in reducing the impact of hidden terminals and maintaining network performance. This work contributes to the advancement of MANET solutions, providing a practical approach to improve connectivity and reliability in challenging wireless environments. Since the existing method Fault tolerant Disjoint Ad hoc On-demand Distance vector (FD-AOMDV) routing algorithm have issues like packet loss, delay and traffic. Our Proposed method provides better simulation results as comparison to the existing method FD-AOMDV.

articleTitle: Effective Automated Drowsiness Detection System Based on Machine Intelligence Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: This paper discusses the development of an effective automated drowsiness detection system using machine intelligence techniques. Drowsy driving is a significant safety concern that can result in accidents, injuries, and even fatalities. To address this issue, we have developed a model that uses machine intelligence techniques such as computer vision and machine learning. The proposed system combines several machine intelligence techniques to detect drowsiness accurately. Computer vision techniques analyze facial features and eye movements to detect signs of drowsiness. The Dataset used was collected by researchers at the University of Texas, Arlington. The system's performance is evaluated using various metrics, including accuracy, sensitivity, roc curve, f1 score, and specificity. The results show that the proposed system is highly effective in detecting drowsiness, with an accuracy of over 80%. Overall, the proposed automated drowsiness detection system is an effective and reliable tool to enhance driving safety. It demonstrates the potential of machine intelligence techniques in addressing real-world problems and improving human life quality.

articleTitle: Wide Common Mode LVDS Receiver Architecture Design and Analysis in 18nm FinFET Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: The high-speed low-voltage differential signal (LVDS) I/O Receiver circuit design and analysis are presented in this work. The Problem identified as proposed design must support high speed LVDS data reception without any loss of data for input low swing with wide common mode range. The suggested LVDS receiver is compatible with the IEEE LVDS protocol. To accomplish the wide common mode voltage range of 0 - 2.4 volts, a receiver with a common-mode suppressor circuit is presented. It also includes a pre-amplifier to boost efficiency of power and give gain of voltage at high frequencies. Low power usage and high-speed signaling are two advantages of LVDS. Also, it doesn't have the significant overshoots and undershoots that high-speed rail-to-rail signaling systems do. Using the Cadence Virtuoso tool, the entire design is realized in an 18 nm (Fin Field Effect Transistor) FinFET process. The receiver operates with 3.2 Gbps data rate while consuming 6.805 mW of power and 3.780 mA of current. In this design transient analysis implemented with the aid of Eye diagrams, rise and fall delays, P2P fall/rise jitter is measured in low and high temperature ranges for Typical, Slow, and Fast corners with various common mode input signals. Using a 1.8V supply at a typical corner level, AC modelling yields a Gain of 20.7477. For different common mode voltage ranges, such as 100mV, 1.2V, and 2.3V, Monte Carlo simulations of duty cycle, rise, and fall delay characteristics were also tabulated. The proposed design achieved the targeted problem statement by supporting 0-2.4V wide common mode voltage range with high speed of 3.2Gbps compare to any other existing designs. Also, this proposed design supports different applications at different voltage levels.

articleTitle: Content Replica Placement Method for Fault Tolerance in Fog Computing Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: An architecture known as fog computing employs edge devices to perform a significant amount of processing. The fog layer supporting the cloud computing paradigm helps to improve quality of services (QoS) in time-critical applications. The high dynamic and heterogeneous nature of devices at the cloud edge causes failures to be a popular event and therefore fault tolerance became indispensable. Fault tolerance is a significant concern in fog computing for reliable service delivery. Most early fault-tolerant methods did not highly consider time-sensitive requests. This paper proposes a novel file or content replica placement protocol for fault tolerance of fog computing network. The proposed consists of two steps. In first step, proposed method firstly classifies the failure risk of the fog servers available for cache placement based on data of their failure history. In the second step we have proposed replication-based fault tolerance method to replicate the content or file on the fog server, which is less prone to fail. For performance assessment we have used parameters such as recovery, availability, and bandwidth usage. Simulation results verify the efficacy of the proposed scheme is compared with random replica placement and replica-3 method. As a result, the proposed is providing better recoverability (approximately an average of 18% and 37%) and improved availability as compared to RREP and Replica-3 method, less bandwidth (approximately an average of 51%) than the Replica-3 method.

articleTitle: Automatic White Blood Cell Classification Using Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Peripheral blood smear analysis is a commonly used technique for existing abnormalities in the health status of humans. Disorders in White Blood Cell (WBC) ratio imply the existence of diseases such as leukemia, lymphoma, anemia, and myelodysplastic syndrome (MDS). Deep learning techniques have gained promising results in many medical-related tasks such as dermatology, ophthalmology, and gastroenterology. In this paper, we developed a novel Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) architecture for leukocyte classification from microscopic peripheral blood cell images which help in the diagnosis of hematological disorders. To boost the performance of the proposed model and avoid overfitting phenomena we leveraged data augmentation techniques of rotation, flipping, width shift, and height shift. Unlike the conventional practice for designing a custom CNN model, we stacked homogenous layers and larger kernels in the early layers. To evaluate the performance of the proposed model, we have used classification metrics of accuracy F1- scores. The proposed model achieved an accuracy of 98.13% on the LISC dataset and then benchmarked against the state-of-the-art approaches.

articleTitle: Human Facial Emotions Recognition Using Customized Deep Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Human facial emotions are an important aspect of interpersonal communication since they are a vital means of conveying feelings. It's been an exciting and difficult task in computer vision to automatically analyze these nonverbal expressions. This activity has a wide range of applications, some of which include productive marketing, psychology, and process automation, amongst others. Many areas of study, including computer vision's application to a wide range} of real-world issues, have benefited greatly from the use of deep learning. In this work, deep convolutional neural networks are proposed to detect various human emotions such as sad, happy, neutral, surprise, fear, disgust and anger. We proposed a deep convolutional neural network strategy for identifying human facial emotions. To validate and test the network, Kaggle face expression recognition (FER-2013) dataset is used, and experimentation is performed based on Python tools. Our proposed model achieved an effective significant performance compared to state-of-the-art techniques with overall system accuracy of 92.14%.

articleTitle: Design of Neural Network Based Controller for Switching Regulator in DC-DC Boost Converters
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: The primary objective of switching regulators is to efficiently convert, regulate, and manage electrical power, guaranteeing stable and effective operation of electronic systems in diverse applications. In this research work a Conventional DC-DC Boost Converter (CBC) and a two-phase Interleaved DC-DC Boost Converter (IBC) were employed in a Switching Regulator. A cascade controller based on Artificial Neural Network (ANN) was implemented on both the CBC and IBC, where the networks were trained using algorithms such as Levenberg Marquardt (LM), Bayesian Regularization (BR), and Scaled Conjugate Gradient (SCG). Consequently, the implementation of ANN resulted in reduced time domain parameters such as settling time, rise time, and peak time compared to the Conventional Proportional Integral (PI) Controller.

articleTitle: Effective UV-C (Ultraviolet) Air Flow Disinfection System for Burn Patients Outside Intensive Care Unit
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: In the face of an epidemic, it has become apparent how crucial premises disinfection is to our lives.
