Microorganisms in the air are as hazardous as coming into contact with an affected person. Patients with serious burns or infectious diseases require medical treatment. Infection of healthy tissues surrounding the wound needs surveillance and infection control, and it is followed by increased concentrated warmth, pain, or discomfort. That's why it necessitates the deployment of a disinfection system capable of purifying the air containing germs and viruses and delivering high air quality to the patient's room. The work presents a system, specifically designed for patients who require special healthcare services along with pure and healthy disinfected air, in order to survive their disease and be protected from microbes and viruses. A comparative study was done to evaluate the effectiveness of the system using nutrient agar medium and 2 hours of sterilized air to eliminate all microbes. There was no bacterial growth on the dish.

articleTitle: Discriminative Feature Extraction Based on SWM for Playback Attack Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: This paper proposes discriminative features for playback attack detection (PAD) based on statisticallyweighted magnitude spectrum (SWM). The proposed SWM method aims to magnify differences between playback and genuine speech through a discriminative feature, namely, statistically weighted magnitude spectrum constant-Q cepstrum coefficient (SWM-CQCC). The ASVspoof 2017 evaluation set is used to evaluate the proposed method. Our experimental results show that SWM-CQCC can outperforms most of all existing methods we are aware of including published implementations of I-Vector and VESAIFCC.

articleTitle: XAI-AMD-DL: An Explainable AI Approach for Android Malware Detection System Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Efficient malware identification is essential to safe the system resources and privacy of data for cybersecurity system. The use of android smartphones has increased tremendously that attracting various types of malware attacks. Nowadays, malware writers use Artificial Intelligence (AI)-enabled malware attack techniques to bypass the detection of malicious activities. Hence, designing an efficient, effective and robust malware detection system to identify malware variants remains a critical problem and challenge. However, number of deep learning (DL) models applied for effective android malware detection in existing methods at large scale, but these models actually lacks interpretability of the models to explain the contribution of each features to the detection system. Therefore, this paper propose an Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) based hybrid Convolutional Neural network (CNN) and Bi-Gated Recurrent Unit (Bi-GRU) Android Malware Detection (AMD) System using DL models named as XAI-AMD-DL. The proposed model is evaluated the using the CICAndMal2019 android malware dataset. The results obtained by the proposed XAI-AMD-DL model is 97.98% accuracy, and 97.75 %, 97.76%, 97.75% precision, recall and f1score, respectively outperforms the existing DL models.

articleTitle: Fiber Optics Transmission Card for Rack based System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Data conversion is one of the necessities in fibre optic rack-based transmitters and receivers. Complex circuits are used for this purpose. Hence the need of the hour is not only to develop simpler circuits, but also to develop circuits with low power consumption and higher data transfer rates with very good immunity for interferences. Our proposed circuits use transmitter cards to collect data from sub system in driver control unit through bus mechanism from back panel in a rack-based fibre optical communication system. The data is converted from electrical to optical in a cost effectively using low power circuits based on TTL logic like AND/NOR circuits. Transmitted pulses by using optical fibre is received in a receiver end and converted back to electrical signal and shared in BUS system to controller's card. Results show that our design is simpler, consumes low power and lesser time for conversion.

articleTitle: Application of Neural Network Intelligent Algorithm in Optimization Path of Manufacturing Structure Upgrading
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Neural network intelligent algorithm has a far reaching impact on the structural form of manufacturing industry, and at the same time promotes the modernization and optimization of manufacturing industry. As the foundation of China's real economy, manufacturing industry is a solid foundation for the sound development of China. The modernization of neural network intelligent algorithm in manufacturing distribution industry has a great impact on the labor market, especially on the industrial structure of manufacturing industry. From labor-intensive to capital intensive production modernization process, through basic theoretical analysis, this paper introduces and analyzes the application status and upgrading optimization of neural network intelligent algorithm in manufacturing structure, and suggests that the number and growth quality of modernization process should be compared and analyzed. Compared with the regional manufacturing production mode in China, most light industries have achieved capital-intensive growth, while most heavy chemical and high-tech industries are eager for the intensive growth of manufacturing structure, so we should find the applicable ways of neural network intelligent algorithm in the process of optimizing production structure.

articleTitle: Identification of Fish Species and Grading in Fish Market Using Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: The identification and recognition of fish species plays a key role in preserving the ecosystem and the fishery industry in quantification on board fishing vessels. Moreover, monitoring methods based on inspection are not effective and take a lot of time. In this paper, we have used a deep learning method to identify six different species of fishes. We followed three major steps: first data augmentation by resizing the images into different sizes. Secondly, make a bounding box and prepare it for the training with YOLOv4 architecture. Finally, a transfer learning method is applied to train the yolov4 model. The data is collected from Nagapattinam fish market in which the model used 80% of the data for training and 20% for testing. According to the experimental result, the proposed model achieves 99.86% accuracy on the test dataset.

articleTitle: Detection of Early Stages of Canker on Apple Tree Using Hyperspectral Imaging Technique to Thwart Canker Spread
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: The early detection of canker can be helpful to thwart the canker disease in apple trees. The canker is a fungal disease that gradually wilts the tree. Using Hyperspectral Imaging (HSI) one can retrieve differences. Hyperspectral Imaging captures a lot more detailed image between 400-1400 nm whilst normal cameras capture only visible spectrum (400 - 700 nm). The ROI of the image falls under wavebands 560, 685, and 1200 nm. A model is created to find the nuances between early infected and later infected areas of an apple tree. The data is multivariate, hence Mahalanobis distance was used on NDSI which is retrieved after measuring spectral reflectance. The overall accuracy of the model is >0.95. This model can be applied to other varieties of apple tree bark and twig canker detection.

articleTitle: Battery Consumption Analysis Using Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: As the economic and environmental conditions of the country push the customers to switch to Electric Vehicles the manufacturing companies are in dire need to upgrade the user experience in and out of the vehicle. The completion in the market and customer demand along with the interconnectivity and artificial intelligence technologies opens a wide range of platforms to develop and design new features to enhance the in-vehicle infotainment experience within the limited resources. This paper presents a multi-faceted analysis of the battery consumption of Electric vehicles which can be used for a better user experience. The Artificial Neural Network is used as the research technology to create a prediction model based on energy consumption at various segments of the vehicle. A database of around 9000 values was used for the analysis obtained from the realtime CAN data of the vehicle procured from the Electric Vehicle in collaboration with Tata Motors Ltd. The Artificial Neural Network Model predicted the output Energy consumption of the battery with high accuracy giving MSE of 0.1142, RMSE of 0.3380, and MAPE of 2.4976%.

articleTitle: IoT-Enabled 6DOF Robotic Arm with Inverse Kinematic Control: Design and Implementation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: This paper presents a research study on an IoT-based robotic arm that utilises an ATmega2560 micro-controller and an ESP8266 WiFi module for network connectivity. The robotic arm is designed to follow inverse kinematic principles and is controlled through REST API communication between a client and a server. The server receives HTTP requests from the client, interprets them, and controls the robotic arm accordingly. Precise manipulation of the robotic arm is achieved through the use of inverse kinematic algorithm. The proposed system is tested through several experiments, demonstrating its practicality and effectiveness in controlling the robotic arm. The proposed system has potential applications in various industries, including industrial automation, agriculture, and healthcare. Overall, this research presents an efficient and effective approach for controlling robotic arms using IoT technologies.

articleTitle: Welcome from IEEE AIC 2023 General Chair
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Welcome to Varanasi, India and to the IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC 2023), jointly organised by Rajkiya Engineering College, Churk, Sonbhadra and Ashoka Institute of Technology, Varanasi, India, on the June, 29-30, 2023 in mixed mode. This conference is financially sponsored by IEEE Madhya Pradesh Section, and Technically Sponsored by UP Section. The theme of the conference is related to the fast developing technology in the area of Soft Computing, AI, IOT, Data analytics and Intelligent Systems. A fundamental stimulus to the investigations of Intelligent Systems is the awareness in the academic communities and industry, the combined approaches will be necessary if the remaining tough problems in Artificial and computational intelligence are to be solved. Recently, Hybrid Intelligent Systems are getting popular due to their capabilities in handling several real world complexities involving imprecision, uncertainty and vagueness. It will be fruitful if recent developments in the communication technology are taken into consideration and are put on test by using global network available and the advancements are taken care of.

articleTitle: An Improved Designing of Neuroprosthetics Arm Using LDA
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Neuroprosthetics have experienced a remarkable evolution in recent times, particularly with the advent of intelligent neuroprosthetics that leverages artificial intelligence (AI) technology. These devices have the potential to improve both the input and output of neurological systems, allowing individuals to control prosthetic limbs with their thoughts and perform everyday tasks such as picking and placing objects. the key to this innovative technology lies in the ability to collect brain signals through electroencephalography (EEG) devices, which can be then deciphered and utilized by the mechatronic components of the prosthetic limb. However, effectively separating relevant signals from irrelevant ones has been a significant challenge for the design and development of neuroprosthetics, as these signals fall into three distinct categories of brain communication. In this research paper, we explore the utilization of split signals in neuroprosthetics using LDA and how this varies from person to person depending on their mental state. Incorporating LDA methods into these devices seems to be the most viable solution for society to build a system that can efficiently differentiate and utilize brain signals, bringing us one step closer to unlocking the full potential of neuroprosthetics. It is found that with the adaptation of the LDA approach, 91% of the results are properly categorized and are best among the existing literature available to date.

articleTitle: Uplift Modelling Applied to a Chilean Retail Company with Siamese Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Marketing is essential for the success of any company today, both to project itself abroad and to achieve its business objectives. The personalized approach to marketing plays a crucial role, enabling more effective interaction with potential customers and reducing errors in promotional campaigns. One way to improve personalized marketing is by using artificial intelligence to predict the effectiveness of campaigns in converting users to customers. In this study, the use of Siamese neural networks for elevation modelling in a Chilean online retail company is proposed. The results obtained using this model are presented, as well as the classical elevation modelling techniques. These results show that the Siamese neural network model achieves an increase of more than 30% compared to the area under the Qini curve, while also being competitive in other metrics. As future work, it is planned to obtain more real data to carry out a better validation of this proposal as well as to compare the model with other proposed neural networks.

articleTitle: Scene Optimization Technology of Digital Twin Virtual Design in Environmental Art
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: With the rapid development of science and technology, we have entered the era of virtual design environment art scene, and virtual reality technology has gradually developed and applied to the field of environmental art (EA). At present, virtual reality technology has not been widely applied, but the role of virtual reality technology in EA design has broken the thinking mode of traditional EA scene, The development prospect is promising. But the virtual design reality technology is not yet fully mature, and the hardware material cost required by the virtual reality technology is very high, so far, the virtual reality technology has not been widely used. But we believe that the virtual reality technology will play its amazing display through the joint efforts of all parties. This paper discusses the application of scene optimization in the EA of virtual design.

articleTitle: Prediction of the Approval of Bank Loans Using Various Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Both individuals and businesses now frequently obtain loans from banks, but because banks have limited resources, they carefully consider each applicant before approving a loan. To determine who the loan can be granted to and who would be a better choice for the bank, for this reason, credit institutions go through a protracted phase of verification and identification. This study aims to employ various machine learning techniques to analyze enormous amounts of data in order to detect patterns that could be used to predict whether a loan would be approved for a particular person or organization and determine whether the borrower can afford to repay the loan or not. Another goal of this study is demonstrating how machine learning will give the banking sector a more reliable predictive modeling tool than it currently has. In this work, the data was gathered from 1000 records of applicants with 16 features from the reputed bank in the city of Dhaka, Bangladesh. Finally, the following seven data mining techniques are employed for accuracy, and suggestions are made regarding how to make the loan approval process more effective and affordable for both banks and borrowers by dramatically lowering the time and effort needed: Decision Tree, Gradient Boosting, Random Forest, Naive Bayes, Support Vector Machine, and Logistic Regression are some examples of machine learning techniques. At the conclusion of the study, the Random Forrest method has the highest accuracy.

articleTitle: Deep Learning and Sensor Fusion Technique for Indigenous Intelligent Vision System for Theft Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: This paper proposes an indigenous system with modified architecture to classify different kinds of objects used in burglary and certain suspicious activities identified in thievery. The classifier used is a part of the security system to detect the images/ movements pertaining to theft or unusual acts while shoplifting valuable objects from jewellery stores. A sequence of integrated real-time computer vision algorithms and sensor fusion technology are implemented. The system adopts the transfer learning method (has 68 layers, 75 connections) as a pre-trained neural network to identify the unusual objects. Here, a person can take suitable action to aid the situation. The classifier algorithm was trained on a dataset of 144 cases of images and augmented appropriately belonging to seven different classes. It provides an accuracy of 97.73% during the validation phase and the confusion matrix resulted in an accuracy close to 95% and an F1-score of 84%.

articleTitle: Enhancing the Cyber-Security of Battery Management Systems for Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: The increasing use of renewable energy and electric vehicles has led to the widespread adoption of battery management systems (BMS) in energy storage. As BMS becomes more advanced and also becomes more vulnerable to cyber threats. This research paper presents an analysis of the challenges and solutions for enhancing the cybersecurity of BMS. This study examines the current state of BMS cybersecurity, identifies the major threats, and discusses various strategies to enhance the cybersecurity of BMS. This research paper begins by providing an overview of BMS, followed by an analysis of the cybersecurity risks associated with these systems. The study discusses BMS's different types of threats, including malware and cyber-attacks, and also examines the challenges in enhancing the cybersecurity of BMS, such as the lack of awareness and the complexity of BMS. This study proposes solutions to enhance the cybersecurity of BMS, including the use of encryption, access controls, and security protocols, and also discusses best practices for cybersecurity in BMS, including the need for regular updates and patching of software and firmware. This research paper concludes by presenting case studies of cybersecurity threats and solutions in BMS. These case studies demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed solutions and best practices in mitigating cyber threats to BMS. This research paper is a valuable resource for energy storage system designers, operators, and users, as it provides insights into the challenges and solutions for enhancing the cybersecurity of BMS.

articleTitle: The MVC Model Based on the Internet of Things is Built in the Agricultural Product Sales Platform System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: As the 21st century has entered the third time, so are various personalized needs. As a special product in agricultural products, more and more rural areas have witnessed the upsurge of local products trading under the background of green agricultural products advocated by the state. It has become an urgent problem to give full play to the characteristics of local products, so that users can understand the current trends and rich information of local products without leaving home. Therefore, this paper proposes a framework of local product sales website from the practical perspective. The local specialty sales website is a classic case of the integration of economic technology and computer technology. The main functions of this website include: specialty area management, warehousing record management, purchase record management, etc. Users can release transaction timely provision of information using this system, and can also complete online transactions. we primarily studies the combination of java and mysql to build a web local product trading platform. First, the local product trading platform, puts forward the architecture design of the website, and then introduces various tools and technologies required by the platform, which is sufficient to explain the module design and provide users with a convenient local product trading platform.

articleTitle: A Leader Election Algorithm Using Blockchain for IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Nowadays, the demand for Internet of Things (IoT) applications is continuously increasing. It is observed that the future scope of IoT is vivid. Therefore, the research industries have focused kind attention towards development of the innovative solutions. IoT is a group of heterogeneous devices and networks. More commonly, the IoT components work under the control of centralized access point or node. IoT uses access point for better coordination, data aggregation, data exchange, etc. Access point or node help to make better decisions and improve overall system efficiency. The access point may have an immense challenge to control diverse range of devices equipped with uncommon features. Also, security becomes a major concern in IoT. In this paper, we propose a blockchain based leader election algorithm for IoT. Here, access points act as full nodes in the blockchain. Full nodes participate in the election process. Under the control of an access point, one device will be selected which will be designated as a leader for access points. Our propose algorithm guarantee a leader, once election process terminates.

articleTitle: Construction of Information Security System in Earthquake Industry
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: The author puts forward his own views on the development of informatization of earthquake prevention and disaster reduction at present and requirements of seismic industry information system, and how to do a good job of information security combined with hierarchical protection in the current environment. Taking Shandong Seismological Bureau as an example, through the research of security technology system and security management system and the use of IPSec VPN, UTM and other technologies to build a self-defense system and the overall deployment and implementation of the system, a set of information security system is finally established. Through the author's work in this field, it is found that it is of great practical significance to apply the research results of the security system to the information business of the whole earthquake industry. The research results and experience of this technology can be applied to the relevant units of the national seismic system, so that the information network system of the whole industry can be greatly improved in resource utilization and work efficiency.

articleTitle: Implementation of Logic Gates and Combinational Circuits Using Neural Network On FPGA For Neuromorphic Hardware
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Neuromorphic computing offers promising avenues for designing highly energy-efficient computing systems. This makes them well-suited for applications that require high-performance computing while minimizing power consumption, such as in edge devices, IoT devices, and autonomous systems. In this work, we proposed a technique for neuron FPGA implementation using Verilog HDL. We have used single layer and multi-layer perceptrons to implement the logic gates and combinational blocks by using the unit-step Function. The hardware implementation of the proposed design was created and tested on a Nexys 4 DDR FPGA board, realized by using Verilog HDL on Xilinx VIVADO and simulated for different inputs value. The proposed neural-based logic gates and combinational blocks emulate similar behavior as conventional blocks. The proposed design could play an important role in future neuromorphic VLSI system design and provides flexibility and adaptability, allowing for easier modifications and adjustments as needed.

articleTitle: An Algorithm to Solve the Euclidean Single-Depot Bounded Multiple Traveling Salesman Problem
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: In the Multiple Traveling Salesman Problem (MTSP) we are given <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$n+1$</tex> cities, among which there is one distinct city called depot and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$k$</tex> salesmen. A tour for each salesman that starts from the depot, ends also in depot and visits once some other cities, is to be constructed. The cost of a tour is the sum of the individual costs of each pair of cities from that tour. There are lower and upper bounds on the number of cities that each salesman has to visit. Respecting these restrictions, we wish to minimize the total cost of all <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$k$</tex> tours. We study the two-dimensional Euclidean case and suggest a 3-phase heuristic algorithm. At phase 1 we partition the whole set of cities into <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$k$</tex> disjoint subsets. At phase 2 we built a feasible tour for each of these subsets. Phase 3 is designed to improve the tours of phase 2. Among the 22 known benchmark instances, our algorithm improved the best known solutions (BKS) for 12 of them, for 4 benchmark instances we obtained the earlier best known costs, for 4 of the instances our algorithm gave an approximation gap within 3% of the BKS, and for the remaining 2 instances the approximation gap was more than 3%.

articleTitle: Unconstrained Face Recognition from Image Sequence
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: This paper presents the breakdown of the Unconfined Experience Detection Quality inside an unimpeded face recognition environment. It provides the output from matched image face with recognition from image sequence. It also gives the capabilities similar inequity, light, and expression modification approach. It might be useful for both proof and identity. At this point in time, it will find plenty of way of front view face-recognition. Beforehand few years, for computer-vision, numbers of face recognition methods have been organized. But, real-planet face-detection tranquil credits an interesting works. The fascination with unconstrained suitable face-recognition is increasing utilizing the explosion of online media for sample community schemes, and video investigation video somewhere come upon assessment is of great meaning. Goal of research is RFG concentrated unconstrained face recognition to enhance the exhibition quality. The Method and Simulation of proposed sensing techniques will probably be completed with the use of MATLAB and output with matched query image from save directory.

articleTitle: Malaria Incidence Prediction Using Leaky Integrate and Fire Neuron
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: A malaria parasite is transmitted to humans with female anopheles bites. Malaria is a common disease in rural and urban areas of most countries. Malaria affects public health and flourishes mainly in sub-tropical countries and tropical countries. The impact of the disease is high, whereas the prevention control system facilities are limited. A prominent prediction model is needed to overcome the effects of malaria disease and prevent infected humans from it. In this study, we focus on determining the malaria-abundant regions with the help of environmental factors and utilizing spiking neural networks as a classification/prediction model for the Ponda region in Goa, India. Groundwork findings of malaria-abundant areas are collected using clinical data from a renowned regional hospital. Leaky integrate and fire neuron models exhibited interesting spiking patterns, which are further used for classifying the malaria-prone zones. This model also demonstrated the best prediction accuracy of 98.47% and 90.87% for village Boma using the MalariaDataset2 and Curti using the MalariaDataset1, respectively. This study tries to contribute a step forward in making India a malaria-free country, a target set by World Health Organization.

articleTitle: Cancer Detection in Lungs Using Image Processing and Liquid Biopsy Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Lung cancer is the most fatal type of cancer, which results from abnormal cell growth in the lung tissue. It is a leading cause of cancer-related deaths globally, and early detection is crucial for successful treatment and improved patient outcomes. Various methods are available for detecting lung cancer, such as imaging techniques like chest X-rays, computed tomography (CT) scans, and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), as well as non-invasive diagnostic methods like liquid biopsy. Liquid biopsy involves identifying biomarkers in blood or other bodily fluids, such as circulating tumor cells (CTCs) or cell-free DNA (cfDNA), which can indicate the presence of lung cancer. The proposed system uses CT scans to obtain lung tissue images and applies image processing algorithms to identify and classify potentially cancerous regions. In addition, the system uses liquid biopsy to detect CTCs or cfDNA in the patient's blood. The system employs a multi-stage process, including pre-processing, segmentation, feature extraction, and classification, to enhance the accuracy of lung cancer detection. Evaluation of the system's performance using a dataset of CT images and liquid biopsy results from patients shows that the combination of image processing and liquid biopsy improves the accuracy of lung cancer detection compared to using image processing alone. These findings are significant and have implications for the development of advanced systems for automated lung cancer detection that incorporate image processing and liquid biopsy.

articleTitle: Application of Bayesian Algorithm in Power Marketing Decision-making
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Marketing decision is the main content of electric energy product sales, but in the marketing process of electric power enterprises, market changes and sales methods will impact the decision-making results and reduce the sales of electric energy products rationality. this paper proposes a Bayesian algorithm to analyze the decision-making of electric energy product sales, improve the level of marketing decision-making, and shorten the time of marketing decision-making. Then, the market data is evaluated. Finally, continuous monitoring is used to observe the sales of electric energy products. Bayesian algorithm can accurately make sales and marketing decisions of electric energy products, improve the sales level of electric energy products, and the rationality is greater than 94 % is better. Bayesian algorithm can meet the requirements of sales and marketing decisions of electric energy products.

articleTitle: Analysing Effectiveness of Different Physiological Biomarkers in Detecting Stress
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Stress is a common part of our everyday life and helps us to handle certain situations in a better way. However, exposure to stress over a long period of time can cause mental and physical health complications. Many health complications associated with stress can be prevented with its early detection. Stress in humans is accompanied by certain physiological changes and monitoring those changes can help in its detection. In this, we study the impact of different physiological changes on stress detection. Different machine learning and deep learning techniques viz. Random Forest, AdaBoost, Decision Trees, Gaussian Naive Bayes and Artificial Neural Networks were used for stress detection using WESAD dataset, which is a dataset for stress and affect detection. Artificial Neural Network outperformed the machine learning techniques and achieved an accuracy of 93.6%. To analyse the effectiveness of each physiological biomarker in detecting stress, the artificial neural network was trained separately on every possible combination of biomarker set. The series of experiments showed that only three physiological biomarkers viz. three axes acceleration, electrodermal activity and body temperature, are sufficient to detect stress effectively.

articleTitle: Improved Deep Learning Model for Aspect Words Extraction
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Deep learning has recently been successful in numerous academic areas, including social network filtering, image processing, machine translation, and text mining. There is a lot of user-generated content available on various social media sites. that can be used for precise opinion analysis of the shifting market dynamics. Aspect word extraction (AWE) task detects the targets of user opinions from the text in aspect-level sentiment analysis (ABSA). The majority of aspect retrieval methods depend on a certain domain or context. Additionally, it is difficult to identify the most pertinent aspect phrases that are domain-specific because there is a deficiency of topic and situational knowledge. The current methods fail to extract some useful aspect terms because they are unable to identify noun phrase dependencies over time. In order to enhance the AWE challenge, this research suggests a combined language patterns with deep learning methods. On typical review datasets, results from studies and experiments are examined for many kinds of aspects.

articleTitle: A Novel Data Mining Algorithm for Power Marketing Information
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Electric power marketing is the main content of the development of electric power enterprises, but in the process of power production, market changes and sales methods will have an impact on the sales results and reduce the effectiveness of power marketing. This paper suggests a data mining procedure to analyze power marketing, improve the development level of electric power enterprises, and shorten the time of marketing plan formulation. Then, a comprehensive assessment of the market data is conducted. Finally, continuous monitoring is used for power marketing and the final sales results are output. The results show that the data mining algorithm can perfectly transfer out power marketing, improve the glassy of power marketing, and the effectiveness is bigger than 95%, which is better than the market research method. The data mining process can meet the requirements of power marketing and is fit for the continuous study of the development of power enterprises.

articleTitle: Devanagari Character Recognition Using MLP-Mixer and CNN Extracted Features
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Devanagari is an ancient script that is used to write Hindi, Nepali, Marathi, Maithili, Awadhi, Newari, and Bhojpuri, among other Indo-Aryan languages. Thousands of individuals in India use this script to write documents in Marathi and Hindi. Indian mythology is based on this script. Because of the script's prominence, handwritten Devanagari character identification has grown in popularity over time. In this paper, we present a comparative analysis of different machine learning and deep learning models for Devanagari character recognition. MultiLayer Perceptron(MLP) Mixer is the technology we're using because extensive research has been done in Devanagari Text Recognition using Convolutional Neural Networks(CNN). This paper aims to provide a comparison between traditional models and a newer model(MLP Mixer). We have used CNN as a standalone deep learning model for our problem and used it for feature extraction. We have also developed some traditional machine learning classifiers using these learned complex features.

articleTitle: A Study on Barriers to Data Science in Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Competitive advantage is the key to survival for all organizations. Embracing innovation provides enterprises with a competitive advantage. One such innovation, data science, is proving to be valuable for the success of businesses by increasing their customer bases, revenues, and profits. Every organization, big or small, generates data. However, micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs) are not able to innovate themselves through data science. This research examines the literature to determine the predominant barriers to data science in MSMEs and lay a foundation for a quantitative study in this area.

Author Keywords: Small Business Growth with Data Science
Big Data for small and medium enterprises (SME)

articleTitle: Health Status Prediction On Multiple Disease Using Machine Learning Approaches
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Health is the most important factor in the life of a man or woman in environment. People have been struggling due to Covid19 in recent years and doctors have been unable to decide whether or not the Covid could continue to plague the man or woman. The device stopped working well in this situation as the covid-19 people had been harmed with numerous diseases at that time and there was no device that anticipated the circumstance in that caused the man or woman to have so many lost life. Several current techniques can anticipate disease during screening evaluation. In addition, fewer technologies are available that can predict a wide range of diseases. Since the symptoms of many diseases are identical, device are fails to predict the multiple disease, this model predict the device without correlation

articleTitle: Comparative Performance Analysis of Genetic Algorithm Variants on Solving 0/1 Knapsack Problem
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Practical optimization issues are primarily and commonly addressed by EAs(Evolutionary Algorithms). A wellliked subset of EA, the Genetic Algorithm (GA), is renowned for its capacity to solve various optimization problems. This research work examines the possibility of the Genetic Algorithm (GA) to resolve the 0/1 Knapsack problem. In this study, a number of mutation and crossover types are used to solve 0/1 Knapsack problem. The effectiveness of GA is compared by utilizing various crossover and mutation combinations. Positively, GA may solve the problems substantially faster and with a reasonable degree of accuracy as compared to traditional methods. In a careful assessment of the stated behavior of GA, combination on three mutations and three crossover methods are explored in this study.

articleTitle: Frequency Regulation of Virtual Inertia Based Isolated Microgrid System Using Pelican Optimizer Based Fractional Order Proportional Integral - (1+PDF) Controller
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: This research presents a new load frequency controller tuned by recently developed Pelican Optimization Algorithm (POA) in virtual inertia based isolated microgrid involving of wind turbine, photovoltaic, and battery system with Phase locked loop (PLL) dynamics. In first stage, a fractional order of PI controller (FOPI) cascaded with 1 plus derivative filter based PD acronym as FOPI-(1+PDF) controller is proposed and compared with POA tuned PID, PI-PD, PI-PDF, PI-(1+PDF) and FOPI-PDF controllers for single step disturbance. Objective function used here is the integral of time multiplied absolute error (ITAE). The superiority of POA FOPI-(1+PDF) controller is witnessed over other controllers with single step disturbance for frequency regulation. In the second step, the ability of the proposed technique is established through its superior performance compared to other controllers for frequent step disturbances. Hence, proposed POA-tuned FOPI (1+PDF) controllers with improved dynamic response and the lowest ITAE (ITAE=1.9215), demonstrates its worthiness for frequency regulation of low inertia microgrid.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Rural Industry Integration Evaluation Software System Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Based on the evaluation index system of rural industrial integration level constructed by the analytic hierarchy process, this paper uses Spring MVC framework and Mybatis and other technologies to develop the evaluation system of rural industrial integration development level based on SSM architecture. The evaluation system was applied to the evaluation of the development level of rural industrial integration in a certain area, and the evaluation results were highly consistent with the expert evaluation results, which verified the scientific and practical nature of the system and improved the efficiency of the evaluation of rural industrial integration development.

articleTitle: Student's Performance Prediction Using Modified PSO
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: In the present-day education system, evaluating students' performance is very important. The prediction of student performance is helpful to students and instructors in maintaining a student's progress. Presently, institutions are implementing Continuous Evaluation Systems. This system is beneficial for improving the students' performance and helps increase their regularity in their studies. This work proposed a new version of the particle swarm optimization algorithm to classify students into different categories based on their performance with the help of various factors. The proposed model modified the strategy to increase the optimization algorithm's efficiency. This model deals with the bag of features with the modified optimization algorithm to recognize students' performance based on 33 features. These features are used for training, validation, and testing of the student's performance and generate a classification report which includes F-measure, recall, precision, and accuracy. Based on the classification report, the proposed model is compared with the existing methods, and the better performance of the proposed model is ascertained.

articleTitle: Intelligent Control Strategies for Enhancing Power Quality in Hybrid Renewable Energy System for Agricultural Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: This paper presents a study on intelligent control strategies aimed at improving power quality in hybrid renewable energy systems (HRES) for agricultural applications. The increasing adoption of renewable energy sources, such as solar and wind, in agricultural settings necessitates effective control techniques to ensure reliable and stable power supply. The proposed intelligent control strategies leverage advanced algorithms to optimize the operation of various system components, including renewable energy sources, energy storage systems, and loads. The strategies encompass energy management systems (EMS) that monitor and coordinate the operation of different energy sources and storage systems, predictive control algorithms that utilize real-time data and predictive models to anticipate power generation and demand, smart grid integration techniques for seamless interaction between the hybrid system and the grid, and fault detection and diagnostic algorithms for identifying and mitigating issues that may affect power quality. The effectiveness of these intelligent control strategies is assessed through simulation studies and experimental validations in representative agricultural environments. The results demonstrate improved power quality, enhanced energy utilization, and increased system reliability, highlighting the potential of intelligent control strategies for optimizing hybrid renewable energy systems in agricultural applications.

articleTitle: A Stable Deep Learning Model for Recognizing Human Actions in Noisy Videos
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: The widespread application and development of technology have significantly improved people's lives. In recent years, deep learning has emerged as a powerful branch of artificial intelligence, enabling the creation of intelligent software and robots that assist with various daily tasks. Deep Learning, a subtype of Complex Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs) based on machine learning, is commonly used for accurate human behavior detection from smartphone data. In this paper, we propose a model to identify human activity using ConvLSTM, DenseNet, and LRCN. The statistical model is built on a substantial dataset of videos sourced from publicly accessible datasets UCF50 and HMDB51, which cover a wide range of activity variables. Our results demonstrate that the DenseNet-based model outperforms other models in terms of accuracy.

articleTitle: Breast Cancer Cell Segmentation Using Attention-Based Deep Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Early diagnosis is crucial for the treatment of breast cancer, the most prevalent disease in women globally. Segmenting cancer cells from photographs of breast tissue is an important first step in the assessment of breast cancer. Here, we propose a deep neural network that uses attention to aid in the separation of breast cancer cells. The proposed technique employs an encoder-decoder architecture with an attention mechanism to zero on the most relevant parts of a picture. We tested the proposed approach on a collection of breast tissue pictures and compared the results with those obtained using the current best practices. Our experiments show that the proposed technique achieves outstanding performance, with an accuracy of 97.26 percent, sensitivity of 95.26 percent, specificity of 98.98 percent, and Jaccard index of 0.89.

articleTitle: Automatic Assessment System Using Topic Modelling and TF-IDF Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Topic modelling has changed the way to do text mining. It is a technique to discover topics and make clusters of similar words in large volume of documents. After analyzing almost 3000 medium articles on topic modeling, an extensive survey on topic modelling has been presented in this paper. It includes Topic modelling methods, different evolution models of latent Dirichlet allocation (LDA) and its utilization in different areas of technology. The LDA operate and assess documents in the form of multinomial distribution. Similarly, every topic is assessed in the form of multinomial distribution over words. LDA can calculate and analyze the steadily increasing words in a particular corpus and can be utilized as a good resemblance of natural text. Essays are most useful ways for checking knowledge, but manual grading might miss out on some minor details and lead to errors in result generation. Therefore, we believe that automatic assessment system is an optimal solution to tackle this issue. We propose using Topic Modelling usage for the assessment system. Our research paper is an attempt to investigate whether automatic assessment systems can detect similar information without guessing meaning of sentences based on in structurally different texts, the way examiner does without guessing meaning of sentences based on word or need to classify entire document based on topic before evaluation. Earlier research on these methods show that machine matches four out of five human findings which also gives room for improvement.

articleTitle: Minimum Selection Feature Importance Guided Attack
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Machine learning models are under severe threat by adversarial attacks. Machine learning is swiftly taking on a central role in organizations' value propositions, and as a result, organizations need to safeguard them. Like every machine learning model, adversarial attack algorithms are trained on data. Recently, specific a I gorithms have been developed for tabular datasets such as the Feature Importance Guided Attack (FIGA) [1]. However, FIGA assumes the knowledge of the total available data for training. In a typical case, the attacker will query a target model (an oracle) to label their training data and perform an adversarial attack on the labelled data. Attackers would like to minimize the queries made in order to remain discreet; however, FIGA requires the maximum amount of data. We present a novel methodology to train FIGA with reduced training samples. This method leverages an intuitive approach that utilizes the K-means clustering algorithm to select legitimate samples from the training data for querying. Our results demonstrate a 99 % reduction in the data required for training.

articleTitle: Study of ECAPA-TDNN Models for Spoken Language Identification Task
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Spoken Language Identification (LID) is the task to identify the language spoken by the speaker regardless of gender, accent and age. In this paper, we study a state-of-the-art deep learning (DL) architecture, named Emphasized Channel Attention, Propagation, and Aggregation in Time Delay Neural Networks (ECAPA-TDNN) in context of LID task. This study focuses on the effects of different input and system parameters on performance of a LID system namely (i) channel size in ECAPA-TDNN model (ii) training data duration and language diversity, and (iii) parameter initialization on ECAPA-TDNN training. This study is carried on VoxLingua107 speech corpora having 107 languages. It is observed that the performance of ECAPA-TDNN model is influenced by all of the above factors. The study brings out that optimal parameter settings can help in achieving a trade off between reasonable accuracy and resource requirements such as amount of training data and time required for training. These are important practical considerations in building of models for language identification task.

articleTitle: Application of Cluster Analysis Algorithm in Informationization Decision of Electric Power Marketing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Electric power marketing is the main content of the development of electric power enterprises, but in the sales process of electric power enterprises, market changes and sales methods will affect the decision-making results and reduce the rationality of power marketing. this paper proposes a cluster analysis algorithm to analyze the information, improve the development level of electric power enterprises, and shorten the time of marketing decision-making. Then, a comprehensive assessment of the market data is conducted. Finally, continuous monitoring is used to make power marketing information decision-making and output the results. The results show that the cluster analysis algorithm can accurately make power marketing informatization decision-making, improve the level of power marketing informatization decision-making, and the rationality is greater.the cluster analysis algorithm can meet the requirements of power marketing information decision-making and is suitable for the continuous analysis of the development of electric power enterprises.

articleTitle: Application of Intelligent Optimization Algorithm for Power Grid Planning Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Power grid planning is the top priority of power system, but in the process of power production, there are problems of unreasonable power grid planning, which impacts the power grid structure and reduces the operational efficiency of the power grid. This paper proposes an artificial intelligence algorithm to analyze the Power grid planning can reasonably adjust the power management level of power system,and identify abnormal loads and power flows. Then, a comprehensive assessment of the distribution network data is carried out. Finally, the dynamic theory is used for grid planning and output of final voltage changes. The results show that the artificial Intelligent algorithm can adjust the key indexes in the power grid, which can quickly and effectively improve the level. the accuracy is greater than 96%, and the overall result is better than the distribution network method. Therefore, the artificial intelligence algorithm can meet the requirements of power grid planning and is good for actual power grid planning.

articleTitle: Application of Decision Tree Classification Algorithm in Power Marketing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Electric power marketing is electric power marketing content, but market changes and sales plans will affect the marketing results and reduce the rationality of direct marketing.this paper take a decision tree algorithm to analyze the marketing plan, improve the level of power marketing. Then, the external environment is evaluated from multiple angles. Finally, the planning theory is used to formulate the marketing plan and output the final marketing plan. The results show that the decision tree algorithm can accurately analyze marketing plans and improve the overall level of direct marketing, and the rationality is greater than 90%, which is better than the past Market Research Act. Therefore, the decision tree algorithm can meet the requirements.

articleTitle: A Robust Vehicular Control System with Collision Detection and Avoidance Mechanism using SVM Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: The proliferation of urbanization, population, and transportation infrastructure has led to an increase in the number of vehicles on the roads, leading to higher accident rates. This paper endeavors with implementing a real-time based vehicular control system with smart alcohol, seat-belt, speed, collision detection and avoidance system. The system has undergone extensive training to distinguish high-risk and low-risk scenarios by incorporating Support Vector Machines with radial basis function to classify and manage potential accidents with a remarkable accuracy rate of 95.8%. If any accident occurs the system is capable of tracking and reporting the accident and its location to the nearest police station with the help of GSM and GPS module. This research integrates advanced technologies and machine learning algorithms to develop a highly efficient and reliable vehicular control system, contributing to the advancement of the field.

articleTitle: Predicting the Happiness Index of the Teachers Fraternity Using a Fuzzy Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Our perception of what makes us happy has changed over time and psychologists have put forth various theories to explain how people pursue and experience happiness. The hierarchy of needs theory suggests that people are driven to seek out ever-more complex needs. The paper proposes a fuzzy modeling-based integrated happiness measurement metric for teaching fraternity in higher education institutes. The methodology involves collecting data from teachers and designing a membership function to propose a rule base for a fuzzy system with the help of experts. The metric is expected to help in taking corrective or encouraging steps to improve the study and research environment of the university. The paper also demonstrates the process of MFs generation of happiness factors using the statistical data distribution collected from the survey. The rule base generation is supervised by a psychologist. The small value of mean squared error obtained by comparing the actual happiness collected in the data and the happiness metrics generated validates the fuzzy model and proves that the proposed methodology is promising and encourages us to further taking research for refining the model.

articleTitle: Research on the Public Space of Contemporary Cities under the Background of Digital Media Platform Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: With the continuous progress of science and technology, the function of digital media platform has become increasingly perfect, and has become an indispensable technology in our life, helping us integrate various information resources, so as to achieve the purpose of reshaping urban public space. As early as the beginning of the 20th century, some experimental projects and digital platforms appeared. They tried to reorganize the public space of the city, allowing users to superimpose text, pictures, video and audio information on the digital map, thus changing the way people explore the city. This paper exemplifies and analyzes two representative digital media platforms, namely Tiktok and Ctrip. One is a short video interactive platform, and the other is a digital platform that provides tourism related services. They plan and reshape urban space from the perspectives of integrating effective information, creating high-quality information to update urban spatial layout, etc.

articleTitle: Development of IoT-Based Monitoring & Notification System for Cold Stores for Major Seasonal Crops in Rural Areas
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Uttarakhand is the most popular state to produce the fruits and vegetables like Apple, Tomato, Mango, Litchi, Guava, Apricot, Green peas, Cauliflower Capsicum, etc. in India Production is gradually increasing as a result of changing agro-climatic conditions and more readily available bundles of activities. Despite the fact that there is a lot of room to expand output, a lack of advanced cold storage monitoring facilities is becoming a key impediment to realizing the potential. So, this can be overcome through an IoT-enabled monitoring and management system to monitor and manage cold stores remotely using a mobile or web application. Using this, a device system node placed at different locations inside the cold store chamber will sufficient. The device node should be able to monitor the various required environmental factors as well as provide the inputs to the controller for further control and mandatory actions. According to the field study, several environmental characteristics such as store humidity, poisonous gases, temperature, light intensity, risky activities, and others such as employees must be monitored in cold stores in order to maintain the quality of the commodities. As a result, a device node with all of the needed sensors and parts for processing and communicating is planned, produced, and tested with the goal of deploying this system. The device node has been built to monitor and process various environmental factors as well as other operations. As a result, the quality and longevity of all commodities stored in cold storage can be improved.t.

articleTitle: Tri-Band Antenna for Compact Wireless Sensor Nodes Operating at 24/28/39 GHz
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: 5G communication technology is an advanced arena of exploration that enables the communication with lower latency at ultra high speed. Planar antenna structuraes are fetching interest in 5G technology due to its multiband operating frequency and compact dimensions. In this work, tri-band, wide band antenna structure is designed. Antenna has covered 24/28/39 GHz bands with wide impedance bandwidth of 1.5/1/2.1 GHz respectively. T-shaped slot is printed in the ground plane to tune the resonance frequency. 24-GHz frequency spectrum covers the Industrial Scientific and medical band and used for short range communication; 28-GHz and 39-GHz bands are suitable for cellular and device to device communication. Antenna has good radiation efficiency of 92%, 79% and 95%, gain of 5.43 dB, 2.86 dB and 4.73 dB. Energy pattern shows the dipole like radiation characteristics at 24/28/39 GHz respectively.

articleTitle: Bioinspired Sensory Gating in the Artificial Vision System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: When viewed as an enterprise, the healthcare system has important security and privacy requirements, such as protecting patient medical records from unauthorized access, tracking protected drugs, connecting to transportation such as ambulances securely, and conducting secure and intelligent e-health surveillance. Block chain has introduced new ideas in medical data security and safety, and with the right security measures, it may eliminate the tension between sharing data and maintaining anonymity. In this study, we integrate the benefits of cloud computing with block chain to offer a secrecy technique for block chain and IoT. In addition to incorporating IoT and providing Iot solutions to block chain nodes, this method also collects, analyzes, uses, and maintains identity authentication for health information. Interface and overcomes the insufficient computer power of particular blockchainchain routers to verify the data's feasibility and authenticity order to verify the feasibility and authenticity of the data. The simulation experiment shows that the suggested technique is effective. It may handle problems like high computer intricacy, data interchange, and privacy protection while maintaining and confirming the quality of medical data.

articleTitle: A Social Network Analytics Approach of Exploring the Characteristics of Peer Interaction for Senior Preschoolers
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Peers are important others in children's social interactions, and peer interactions promote children's social development. This study aimed to explore the characteristics of peer interaction for senior preschoolers by a social network analytics approach. A total of 34 senior preschoolers were selected from a private preschool in China, and the social network theory was used to analyze the characteristics of their peer interactions based on a 14-day informal class observation. The software of Ucinet 6 was used for data analysis. The results of this study suggest the following characteristics of peer interactions among senior preschoolers: there were significant differences in the centrality of peer networks among different children; there was a tendency for one-way choices and the “gender segregation” phenomenon in terms of choosing friends; peer groups could be divided into closely related subgroups, and there was a core-periphery structure in the whole network of the class; and the individual network indicators were higher for non-only children than for only children. In view of these characteristics of peer interaction, the paper concludes with educational strategies to promote peer interaction among senior preschoolers.

articleTitle: Design of Interleaved DC-DC SEPIC Converter Based Switching Regulator Using Neural Network Based Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: DC-DC Converter based Switching Regulators are widely utilized in industrial and domestic applications, because of high conversion efficiency with reduced power loss. This research work uses an Interleaved DC-DC SEPIC Converter (ISC) to construct a switching regulator because of following reasons: It is a two-stage SEPIC converter with phase-shifted switches operating with decreased reduced ripples, switching stress, and it also employs small size inductors and capacitors for the same output power because of high operating frequency. Here Neural Network (NN) based Cascade Controller is employed to construct ISC based switching regulator. A NN is a machine learning technique used to train data without the need of human intervention. Three different training techniques are utilized to train the NN: Levenberg-Marquardt (LM), Bayesian Regularization (BR), and Scaled Conjugate Gradient (SCG) Algorithm. The time domain parameters for achieving the regulated output voltage have been lowered with the NN machine learning algorithm when compared to the Conventional Proportional Integral (PI) controller.

articleTitle: Multivariate Travel Time Forecasting in a Traffic Network Using Fuzzy Cognitive Mapping
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Traffic forecasting is a crucial component in the implementation of efficient traffic management and control. While various works have been made in this area, most of the current works focus on traffic flow forecasting. Although traffic flow is an important feature in traffic modeling, other variables such as travel time, are also useful in developing robust traffic models. Travel time forecasting is a relatively underexplored area in the literature, especially when additional features are considered in generating the forecasts. This paper uses the fuzzy cognitive mapping approach to develop a multivariate travel time forecasting model. The construction of the FCM uses the pseudoinverse learning algorithm. A case study was performed in a road network in Cebu, Philippines with 20 selected routes. The results of the study showed that the FCM model outperforms the benchmark models in terms of directionality and magnitude. The paper significantly contributes to the literature in three ways. Firstly, it is one of the few works that investigate multivariate travel time forecasting. Secondly, it pioneers the application of FCM to multivariate traffic forecasting. Finally, it is one of the few works offering lenses in the Philippines. The findings in this study would be beneficial for stakeholders, such as traffic practitioners, policymakers, and urban planners in the development of relevant initiatives.

articleTitle: Latency Analysis and Reduction Methods for Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: With the proliferation of mobile networks and the Internet of Things in recent years, latency has become a major issue due to the massive amount of data. The data center location does not allow for the handling of large amounts of data. So it can only be handled if a server is placed near the end user and between the data center and the device. Edge computing is a distributed computing environment that moves computation and data storage closer to the point of use to improve response time and save bandwidth. This paper provides an overview of edge computing technology as well as preliminary observations for determining important characteristics for dealing with the latency analysis problem. This observation is based on a variety of parameters, and how well it works with existing edge computing infrastructure.

articleTitle: Custom-Built Deep Learning Architecture for Identifying Malaria Parasites in Blood Smear Images
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: The Plasmodium parasite, a form of protozoan parasite, invades red blood cells in the human body and is responsible for causing malaria. Malaria is a potentially lethal disease. Malaria diagnosis must be accurate and rapid in order to treat and control the disease efficiently. It is a major public health problem, specifically in tropical areas, and fast and explicit diagnosis is critical for effective treatment. However, due to low contrast, overlapping cells, and other artefacts, visual evaluation of blood smears can be difficult. A Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) system for accurately detecting parasites associated with malaria in blood smear pictures is proposed in this research. Thousands of photos of diseased and unaffected blood cells made up the data set used in this investigation. Multiple pools and convolutional layers are included in the proposed CNN model, which follows fully linked layers for classification. The model's effectiveness was assessed comprehensively by employing well-established metrics, including The metrics used to evaluate the performance include accuracy and loss etc. This evaluation facilitated a thorough and comprehensive analysis. The findings revealed that the CNN model exhibited exceptional capability in accurately identifying and categorizing malaria cells, achieving an impressive accuracy rate of 0.93. These results clearly highlight the significant promise of this approach for diagnosing and managing malaria.

articleTitle: An Effective Feature Selection Technique for Detecting Parkinson's Disease Using Binary Whale Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Parkinson's disease is a neurological condition that affects the nerves of the body and results in uncontrollable body movements like shaking, stiffness etc. Parkinson's disease affects around 10 million people worldwide. Early detection of the disease is very important for patients. The easiest way to detect the disease is with the help of the voice recordings i.e., speech signals. As the speech dataset has very large number of features it is important to choose the optimal feature subset for disease classification. This task is known as feature selection. This work proposes a feature selection approach for efficient detection of the Parkinson's disease based on binary whale optimization algorithm. Eight different transfer functions have been tried and the best one is chosen. The result has been evaluated based on classification accuracy, feature selection ratio and the execution time metrics. A significant improvement of 7.7 % have been achieved over the classical method.

articleTitle: An Effective Image Denoising Approach Based on Denoising with Image Interpolation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Image denoising is a task to remove corrupted pixels from the image. The corrupted pixel betides to the image while capturing and transmission from various sources. For image denoising, many filtering approaches are used in literature. However, the resolution of the image deteriorated due to denoising. Therefore, In the proposed work, denoising is unified with upsampling to get a noise-free informative and magnificent image. In the proposed approach first denoising is performed with the Weighted median filter to remove noise from the image. The Weighted median filter has been extensively used and preferred as it minimizes loss of information by filtering out background noise without generating unrealistic pixels and providing more weightage to the central pixel. The denoised image is then upsampled to have good visual perception quality. Considering the PSNR and SSIM, it has been evident that the proposed method effectively outcompetes the simple denoising methods.

articleTitle: Automatic Power Factor Measurement and Correction Using MyDAQ
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: There are several advantages accruing to a power system with power factor correction. In this paper, automatic power factor correction with measurement of real power, reactive power, and apparent power. The overall losses in the system can be minimized. The advantages of power factor correction extend beyond the balance sheet; there is also a significant benefit to the environment, which means the utility may reduce its carbon footprint and help the environment. In view of these, the measurement of the power factor is very essential and whenever it goes below a critical value, it should be corrected immediately. In this paper, the measurement of the power factor and corrections if required are discussed. These are accomplished with the help of LabViewsoftware and interfacing hardware called my date acquisition (myDAQ) device.

Author Keywords: analog and digital input/ output signals

articleTitle: Cardiovascular Disease Prediction Using Hybrid-Random-Forest- Linear- Model (HRFLM)
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Heart complications has become very common disease among all the age group persons across the globe. The computation techniques available in the market are based different traditional machine learning models. These models are successful based on the type of datasets they have adapted. In this work two models are combined to form a hybrid model (HRFLM) which is suitable for cardiovascular risk prediction. This model utilized different attributes like stress levels, ECG data and others which are ideal for cardiovascular risk prediction. The stress levels are considered as key attribute which is vital for evaluating this hybrid model. The results show that the proposed model has obtained 98.36% accuracy in predicting the cardiovascular disease when compared with other traditional models.

articleTitle: 3D Object 360-Degree Motion Detection Using Ultra-Frequency PIR Sensor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: This research paper introduces a groundbreaking 3D object 360 motion detection system that employs radiation-based active motion detectors. These sophisticated detectors emit electromagnetic waves and meticulously measure the energy differentials pre and post-reflection to discern motion. The system further harnesses the power of wavelet representation for object recognition amidst crowded scenes, harnessing the prowess of dimensionality reduction and support vector machines for efficient and effective learning. Additionally, the paper explores advanced shape detection techniques, encompassing cutting-edge edge detection and precise geometric parameter estimation. It delves into the efficacy of frame subtraction and background subtraction as highly adaptable motion detection methodologies. The study also sheds light on the merits and demerits of diverse motion detection technologies, encompassing infrared sensors, video motion detection, thermal imaging cameras, and radar systems. Through its comprehensive analysis, this research paves the way for future investigations aimed at enhancing accuracy and performance in 3D object 360 motion detection, thus catering to the evolving needs of security and surveillance applications.

articleTitle: Personalized Cardiovascular Disease Risk Prediction Using Random Forest: An Optimized Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: This study investigates the advantages and disadvantages of using a variety of machine learning approaches to estimate an individual person's risk of Cardiovascular Disease (CVD). Not all relevant risk variables specific to an individual may be considered by conventional risk assessment methods because they rely on predetermined risk factors. Algorithms trained on big data sets can identify trends and anticipate individual risks, allowing for more precise and targeted measures against CVD. Different machine learning algorithms are tested for their ability to predict CVD risk using a dataset comprising clinical and demographic factors. Examples of these algorithms are logistic regression, decision trees, random forests, and Support Vector Machines (SVM). Additionally, we investigate how feature-selection strategies and model hyperparameter adjustment can improve ML model efficiency. The study reveals the most critical risk factors for CVD and underlines the potential of machine learning techniques to enhance personalized CVD risk prediction. This research took advantage of data from over 14,000 patients, including detailed information on their demographics, medical histories, and daily routines. The solution outperformed conventional approaches with an accuracy of 90% after training machine learning models on this varied dataset. The personalized data-driven strategy shows potential for improving CVD risk prediction and preventative measures.

articleTitle: Markov Chain Model Used in Agricultural Yield Predictions Utilizing on Indian Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: A new problem is how to adjust farming operations to shifting climatic conditions while using cutting edge agricultural technologies and novel seed varieties. IoT offers a fresh method for adjusting to future problems as a result. Historically, agricultural production was significantly influenced by the weather. The current climate catastrophe has dramatically changed this norm, though. Older seed kinds still generate superior yields when cared for correctly, whereas newer seed varieties have evolved in response to certain climatic and moisture requirements. In this study, we set out to train the machinery to recognize significant developmental stages in the life cycle of the crop, so that it can advise the farmer on how to best care for the machine depending on the circumstances under which the crop thrives. Instead of striving to create a system with predetermined thresholds, this improved agricultural initiative seeks to protect the environment while also meeting the crop's shifting needs throughout the course of its whole life cycle.
